raceinfo_chi.RaceName: 六福珠寶洛神水賦系列讓賽

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Took up a prominent position outside leader, not able to finish off the race under top weight, weakened 300M. (Jockey : progressing from Griffin company and may not have been suited with its allotted weight of 135 lbs.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側的前列位置。在負頂磅下未能以勁勢衝刺。三百米處轉弱。（騎師表示，坐騎自新馬賽升班角逐，獲配一百三十五磅上陣或不合發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Away well, sat 1-1/2L behind the leader on rail, saved ground on turn, hard ridden after passing 300M, took the lead 200M, kept on very well to the line, won by 3-3/4L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。跑過三百米處後受力策。二百米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點，以三又四分三個馬位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on rail, 3 lengths back, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 300M, finished off very strongly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W) 自第一檔起步普通，居中間位置，落後三個馬位，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初未能望空。三百米處望空。末段衝刺凌厲，取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Moderately away, raced prominently on the middle track, peaked 300M, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;出閘普通，居前列，在跑道中央競跑。三百米處未能再增速。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Average to begin, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L at 400M, peaked and headed 150M, weakened gradually close home, just held 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘一般。受催策上前，取得領先。四百米處領先四分三個馬位。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。接近終點時逐漸轉弱，僅保住亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W) Average to begin, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/2L turning in, peaked and headed 200M, weakened gradually final 100M, finished 2nd.
(Mucus in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個半馬位。二百米處未能再增速及被超越。最後一百米逐漸轉弱，跑獲亞軍。
（氣管有痰。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Shifted in at start and made contact, sent forward to take the lead, kicked clear after passing 300M, ran on strongly to the line, easily scored, impressive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時向內斜跑，與他駒互相觸碰，受催策上前領放。跑過三百米處後加速帶離對手。末段走勢強勁。從容勝出，贏得漂亮。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 3-year-old gelding, by Farnan from Islay Inlet, a daughter of Lemon Drop Kid. Horses by the same sire include Grand Eagle and Gaudium Magnum. He was given three trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He raced handily and finished second, beaten by 1/2L, under slight pressure over 800m on turf in Conghua on September 7. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished sixth under the whip, beaten by 8-1/4Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 12. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「輝隆」(Farnan)之後，在港同父馬包括「神鵰」及「極歡欣」等駒，生母出自「檸檬糖」(Lemon Drop Kid)。抵港後三次試閘一次上名。9月7日出試從化草地800米，早段居前競跑，末段稍騎下跑第二名，落後頭馬半個馬位。最近10月12日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段鞭策下跑第六名，落後頭馬8.25個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began only fairly, raced at rear, 6 lengths back in the middle stages, made no progress final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，居後列。中段落後六個馬位。最後四百米毫無進展。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 3-year-old gelding, by Churchill from Blizzardly, a daughter of More Than Ready. Horses by the same sire include Ka Ying Generation and Gutsy Bravo. He was given five trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he shared the lead and finished fourth under pressure, beaten by 8Ls, over 1200m AWT in Conghua on October 8. He’s probably not looking like a first-up winner but this race will give us a chance to look at him more closely.
formguide.comments_chi: 「邱吉爾」(Churchill)之後，在港同父馬包括「嘉應傳承」及「彪形勇將」等駒，生母出自「超妥當」(More Than Ready)。抵港後試閘五次。最近10月8日出試從化泥地1200米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下跑第四名，落後頭馬八個馬位。不似能一出即勝，觀望為宜。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 3-year-old gelding, by Hanseatic from Split Lip, a daughter of Your Song. Horses by the same sire include Bullish Nova and Master Payment. He was given two trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He sat not far behind the pace and finished second, beaten by 2-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1050m AWT at Sha Tin on September 25. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished fifth, beaten 1-3/4Ls, under a hold over 1000m on turf at Sha Tin on October 13. He looks an interesting debutant and could run well here.
formguide.comments_chi: Hanseatic之後，在港同父馬包括「牛精新星」及「支付之父」等駒，生母出自「為你高歌」(Your Song)。抵港後兩次試閘一次上名。9月25日出試田泥1050米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬2.25個馬位。最近10月13日出試田草1000米，早段居前競跑，末段按韁下跑第五名，落後頭馬1.75個馬位。初出應可交出良好表現。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 3-year-old gelding, by Zoustar from Patricia Dawn, a daughter of Sebring. Horses by the same sire include Patch Of Theta and Emblazon. He was given six trials for two wins and three placings in Hong Kong. He sat midfield and finished fifth, beaten by 1L, under the whip over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 5. In the latest trial, he made all to win by 1-1/2Ls under a hold over 1200m AWT in Conghua on October 15. He looks an interesting debutant and could run well here.
formguide.comments_chi: 「摘星勇驥」(Zoustar)之後，在港同父馬包括「手機錶霸」及「會當凌」等駒，生母出自「識奔」(Sebring)。抵港後六次試閘得兩勝三位。10月5日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段鞭策下跑第五名，落後頭馬一個馬位。最近10月15日出試從化泥地1200米，早段領放，末段按韁下以1.5個馬位之先勝出。初出應可交出良好表現。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 3-year-old gelding, by Home Affairs from Mystical Pursuit, a daughter of Needs Further. He will be the first runner of his sire in Hong Kong. He was given two trials for two wins in Hong Kong. He raced handily and won by a neck, under a hold, over 800m on turf in Conghua on September 28. In the latest trial, he made all to win by 5-1/2Ls under pressure, over 1200m AWT in Conghua on October 15. He's a nice horse and could run well here on debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「家事國事」(Home Affairs)之後，是此父系首匹在港上陣馬，生母出自Needs Further。抵港後兩次試閘全勝。9月28日出試從化草地800米，早段居前競跑，末段按韁下以一馬頸位之先勝出。最近10月15日出試從化泥地1200米，早段領放，末段力策下以5.5個馬位之先勝出。潛質不俗，預計初出會有良好走勢。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 3-year-old gelding, by The Autumn Sun from Fire Gully, a daughter of Pierro. Horses by the same sire include Sky Jewellery and Vivacious Win. He was given six trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He sat not far behind the pace and finished third under pressure, beaten by 4L, over 800m on turf in Conghua on March 30. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished sixth under slight pressure, beaten by 2-3/4Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 12. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「秋陽」(The Autumn Sun)之後，在港同父馬包括「首飾天空」及「隨緣得勝」等駒，生母出自「比亞路」(Pierro)。抵港後六次試閘一次上名。3月30日出試從化草地800米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬四個馬位。最近10月12日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段稍騎下跑第六名，落後頭馬2.75個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W2W) Held up, tight for room behind rivals home straight, clear final 100m, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W2W) 留後。直路上在對手之後受緊迫。最後一百米望空，但未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced 3 wide slightly behind midfield early, 2 wide after passing 750M, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 起步時向內斜跑，與對手互相觸碰。早段居中間稍後位置，走第三疊。跑過七百五十米處後走第二疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began well, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader, kept on well to the line to take 2nd, no threat to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘迅速，落後領放馬兩個馬位。末段保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Slightly slow out, positioned 4 lengths behind the leader on the inside, same position on turn, no daylight early in straight, cleared 200M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘略為緩慢，落後領放馬四個馬位，走內疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路初未能望空，二百米處望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Waited with towards rear, dropped to last place into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時墮居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Taken back from gate 10, raced 3 wide towards rear, 7 lengths back turning in, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 自第十檔出閘後留居後列，走第三疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

raceinfo_chi.RaceName: 六福珠寶婚嫁系列讓賽

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Taken back early, sat at the rear on the rail, saved ground, made some headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 早段留居後列，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Sat worse than midfield, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, rail position in mid-field, driven 500m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 起步時向內斜跑及發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Settled in midfield on rail, kept on in home straight until fading steadily inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上保持走勢，直至最後二百米逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Shifted in on jumping and bumped, taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, failed to make any progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 躍出時向內斜跑及與對手互相碰撞，留居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field in rail position, good and smooth headway on final bend, strong run to lead 150m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎順勢追前甚多。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Shifted in at start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 350M, finished off strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 起步時向內斜跑，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。三百五十米處向外移出。末段衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in last few from a wide barrier, baulked behind runners upon straightening, eventually obtained a clear run over 150M out, produced good late impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘，居最後數位之內。入直路時在馬群之後受困。一百五十米處望空，末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W5W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, settled at the tail of the field 7-8L, switched wide turning for home and had work to do, made some progress without threatening leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W5W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居包尾位置，落後七至八個馬位。轉入直路時移出外疊，落後頗遠。其後略為追前，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Sluggish start, three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along 600m out, hampered and lost balance 250m out, eased off.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。六百米處受推策。二百五十米處受阻礙，失去平衡。收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Dropped in from wide draw, some limited headway when running out of room final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後移入內疊。末段略為追前，最後五十米空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat towards rear, held up between 400M to 300M, responded reasonably well when placed under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。四百米處至三百米處之間受困。對催策反應不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Shifted out, made contact and lost ground out of stalls, held up last, switched inside for clear run early in home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 躍出時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰及失地，留居包尾位置。直路初向內移入以望空。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, guided to the fence racing in second half of the field, had 5Ls to make up top of the straight and never looked likely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般。移入內欄，居後半馬群中。直路初落後五個馬位，從未見具爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, settled rear on the rail, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W2W3W) 出閘笨拙。居後列，走內欄。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Slow to begin, ended up racing in last over 10Ls off the pace, in similar position making the home turn before running past a few beaten horses in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 出閘緩慢，居包尾位置，落後領放馬逾十個馬位。轉直路彎時居相若位置。直路上超越數匹已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Slowly away, held up, no impression when ridden along home straight.
(Lost right front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，留後。直路上在催策下毫無表現。
（失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W1W1W) Taken back to race at tail, 8 lengths or so back turning in, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W1W1W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時落後約八個馬位，轉入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Slightly slow out, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。二百米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Taken back to race towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back turning in, made some progress early in straight, not enough room final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路初略為追前。最後一百米空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Towards rear, hampered after 400m, stayed on late into mid-field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居後列。跑了四百米後受阻礙。末段保持走勢，居中間位置過終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Tracked pace, unable to quicken home straight and left behind by winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。直路上未能加速，被頭馬拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W) Sat at the rear on the rail, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Shifted out at start, raced 2 wide in midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, showed no response early in straight, weakened and eased final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路早段對催策毫無反應。最後二百米轉弱，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Dropped out last from wide draw, still plenty to do top of home straight, making ground when severely checked 250m out, one paced after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置。直路初仍落後甚遠。追前，二百五十米處大力勒避，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Sat off midfield 3 wide, one pace when asked. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。在催策下保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W5W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, traveled well, ran on strongly, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W5W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。走勢良佳。以勁勢上前，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Blundered shortly after the start, sat behind midfield, had difficulty obtaining clear running, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 起步後不久失蹄，居中間之後位置。末段難以望空，衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Pressed leader, keen early, under pressure to challenge leader 500m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬，早段搶口。五百米處在催策下挑戰領放馬。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W3W) Sat on pace, raced wide, failed to respond when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W3W) 居前列，走外疊。對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to take a place, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W4W) Sat at the rear 3 wide, closed off okay from the rear. (Barrier manners unacceptable, must BT)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。末段自後列衝刺尚可。（閘廂行為難以接受。必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W4W) Recovered from slow start to race in mid-field, race keenly throughout, driven 400m out, no extra final 200m.
(Blood in trachea and roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘緩慢，恢復走勢後居中間位置。沿途搶口。四百米處受催策。最後二百米再無餘力。
（氣管有血及再次患有喘鳴症。）
runnerrecords.healthissue_chi: （氣管有血及再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, held up in the Straight, stayed on once in the clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路上受困。望空後保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly final 200m, beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米走勢強勁，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled behind midfield, gave ground inside150M
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。一百五十米處墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Settled on pace on the rail, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 10. raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, very wide turning in, made some progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 自第十檔出閘，留居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W4W) Raced wide towards rear, passed a few rivals late, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居後列，走外疊。末段超越數匹對手。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W4W) Bumped on jumping, positioned 2 wide behind midfield, angled out after passing 500M, very wide turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W4W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。跑過五百米處後向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, had to push along early to settle behind midfield, ran on nicely from the rail.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 出閘笨拙。早段須受推策，居中間之後位置。沿內欄以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W3W) In touch with leaders, hampered 600m out, soon struggling and lost place, left behind home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處受阻礙。瞬即掙扎上前，失位。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Dropped back to the rear with the speed underneath, severely checked near the 900M and soon got slightly detached from the field, swung home the widest, made no impression in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 在賽事步速甚快下墮居後列。接近九百米處時大力勒避，瞬即被馬群稍為拋離。直路彎走最外疊。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) In rear after sluggish start, still in rear top of home straight, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步緩慢，居尾列。直路初仍居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W1W) Tracked leaders, struggled to hold position from 700m out, severely checked 500m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自七百米處起難以保持位置。五百米處大力勒避，未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W2W) Always well behind and never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W2W) 沿途遙居於後。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Waited with in rear, keen middle stages, checked 700m out, outpaced final bend, left behind home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。中段搶口。七百米處勒避。直路彎未能跟上步速。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Tracked leader, keen early, ridden along top of home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，早段搶口。直路初受催策。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W4W) Began well from a wide draw, unable to slot in, raced 4 wide better than midfield, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，未能切入內欄，居中間之前位置，走第四疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat last, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Raced in touch, three wide, made effort 300m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 緊隨領先馬匹，走第三疊。三百米處發力。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped well and led, kept on until weakened final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速及領放。保持走勢直至最後七十五米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Tracked pace, ridden to chase leading pair 400m out, unable to stay with that pair, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處在催策下追趕領先兩駒，但未能跟上。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, challenged up rail from 400m out, ran on well and lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 緊隨領先馬匹。自四百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。保持佳勢，僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, under pressure 500m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide better than midfield, wider turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 100M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走更外疊。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Settled worse than midfield on the rail, made minor progress. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Ridden along in last few on rail after moderate start, baulked behind runners from the 800M and forced to check 700M out, fought on steadily from one of the widest into straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，受催策，居最後數位內，走內欄。自八百米處起在馬匹之後受困，七百米處被迫勒避。入直路時為走最外疊馬匹之一，持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Ridden to midfield some 5L back in 6th about 1100M out, slightly worse rounding home bend, kept on same pace without quickening under pressure in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 受催策，居中間位置。約千一米處居第六位，落後約五個馬位。轉直路彎時略為墮後。直路上受催策，但未能加速，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Bumped shortly after the start, raced at rear on the inside, angled out 500M, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，走內疊。五百米處向外移出。直路早段略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Sat towards rear on the rail, traveled smoothly, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居後列，走內欄，走勢暢順。衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield, traveled smoothly, made steady ground late (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走勢暢順。末段穩步上前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Mid division, had to wait for run turning into home straight, short of room 400m out to 100m out, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。四百米處至一百米處空位不足。際遇欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W) In rear after crowded at start, had to wait for run top of home straight, switched wide for clear run 100m out, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列。直路初須等待空位出現。一百米處移出外疊以望空。敗在欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Held up last, race keenly throughout, pushed along widest into home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 留居包尾位置。沿途搶口。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W6W) Taken back to race towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W6W) 留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded and checked leaving stalls, in rear, rail position throughout, unable to quicken in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘時受擠迫及勒避。沿途居後列，走內欄。直路上未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, 3 lengths or so back, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Made contact at start, raced in midfield, 3 wide, wider turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時走更外疊。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, under pressure to hold position 600m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。六百米處受催策以保持位置。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in mid-field, rail position, angled out under pressure 200m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。二百米處在催策下向外移出，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W4W) Bounded on jumping and lost ground, in rear, still in last pair turning into home straight, left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W4W) 躍出時向上跳躍及失地，居後列。轉入直路時仍居最後兩位內。最後三百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W5W) Settled worse than midfield, angled out at the Turn, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W5W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎向外移出。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Held up last from widest draw, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 自大外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began only fairly, taken back to race towards rear on the inside, moved a bit closer in the middle stages, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居後列，走內疊。中段略為追近。入直路後固守內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Raced in rear after bumped leaving stalls, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，其後居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Sat behind midfield, was taken wider near the 900M, switched out entering the Straight, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間之後位置。接近九百米處時被帶出較外疊。入直路時向外移出。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Lifted front feet on jumping and away tardily, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight, eased final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 躍出時一對前腳並舉，出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能望空。最後一百米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to track leaders, challenged and every chance from 300m out, ran on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘後受催策以跟隨領先馬匹。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。以佳勢上前，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Outpaced in rear, hung in and lost balance 900m out, ridden top of home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，未能跟上步速。九百米處內閃及失去平衡。直路初受催策。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began only fairly, raced towards rear, 5 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared approaching 200M, made good progress thereafter to take 2nd. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，落後約五個馬位。直路彎落後相同距離。直路早段未能望空，趨近二百米處時望空，其後追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, chased leaders into home straight, stayed on, unable to reach winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時追趕領先馬匹。保持走勢。未能追上頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Taken back to race at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, pushed along 500m out, short-lived effort top of home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。五百米處受推策。直路初一度發力。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, angled off rail 700m out, ran on well in home straight, lost out only narrowly in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。七百米處移離內欄。直路上以佳勢上前。在多駒幾乎齊過終點下僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, had to wait for run turning into home straight, bumped 250m out, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。二百五十米處發生碰撞。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run until approaching final 100M, finished off well to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 起步時與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至趨近一百米處。衝刺良佳，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure 700m out, strong run final 400m to lead 75m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。七百米處受催策。最後四百米走勢強勁。七十五米處取得領先，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked top of home straight, headed by winner 100m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初加速。最後一百米被頭馬超越，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W4W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Crowded and bumped out of stalls, ridden along from stalls to press leader, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 出閘時受擠迫，發生碰撞，其後受催策，追逼領放馬。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W2W2W) Began well from the widest draw, raced slightly better than midfield on outer early, moved closer after passing 1000M, 2nd in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，早段居中間稍前位置，走外疊。跑過一千米處後追近，中段居第二位。直路初未能再增速，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W1W1W) Away with them, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, took the lead 1100M, found rail after passing 900M, led by a length on turn, peaked and headed 150M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。千一米處取得領先。跑過九百米處後移入內欄。直路彎領先一個馬位。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began only fairly, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, no clear run early in straight, cleared 150M but made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路初未能望空。一百五十米處望空，但其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, sat right behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居領放馬之後，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能望空。

raceinfo_eng.RaceName: LUKFOOK JEWELLERY LOVE IS BEAUTY COLLECTION HANDICAP

raceinfo_chi.RaceName: 六福珠寶愛很美系列讓賽

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, in rear, ridden along 400m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 早段受催策，但未能跟上步速，居後列。四百米處受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Out with rest, raced 3 wide in midfield, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Pushed on to chase leader in a fast run race, struggled to keep up from 500M, already beaten top of straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 在快步速下受推策，追趕領放馬。自五百米處起未能保持走勢。直路初已洩氣潰敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked pace out wide, improved to press leader 900m out, weakened quickly home straight, tight of room 250m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊。九百米處上前追逼領放馬。直路上迅速轉弱，二百五十米處空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Made contact at start, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, there to turn, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 起步時發生觸碰，留居後列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Away with them, positioned 2 wide slightly better than midfield, angled out 550M, showed limited response early in straight, crowded near 200M, eased final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。五百五十米處向外移出。直路初對催策反應平平。接近二百米處時受擠迫，最後一百五十米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Ridden along from gate 1 to lead, headed and weakened last 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，在催策下取得領先。最後二百米被超越，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Stayed close enough to leaders in the 5th spot, kept on at same pace turning home, raced in restricted room 200M for some distance and failed to run on after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹，居第五位。轉直路彎時保持同速。二百米處在一段途程上在窄位競跑。其後未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Pressed forward under 10lb claimer, chased leader going into home turn, fought hard to stay in contention early straight, weakened final 100M. (Jockey reminded to ride out to the finish.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 在獲減十磅的騎師胯下受催策上前，入直路彎時追趕領放馬。直路初力拼以保持爭逐機會，最後一百米轉弱。（騎師被提醒她有責任全力催策坐騎至終點。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat behind the leaders 2 wide, kept on nicely for 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居領先馬匹之後，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled smoothly, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 在催策下領放。走勢暢順。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, challenged and every chance from 400m out, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度極具爭勝機會。保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start settling in rear of midfield on rail, about 5L off the lead in 9th home bend, tight run in 7th after straightening, kept on under pressure without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎居第九位，落後領放馬約五個馬位。入直路後緊迫競跑，居第七位。在催策下保持走勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled towards rear on rail, gained slightly closer around home bend, angled out for a clear run 300M out, responded well under pressure and asserted authority just inside the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。轉直路彎時略為追近。三百米處向外移出以望空。在催策下反應良佳，跑過一百米處後主宰大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W3W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide behind midfield, moved a bit closer after passing 700M, 3 wide on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。過了七百米處後略為追近。直路彎走第三疊。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, three wide in rear of mid-field, commenced move out wide 550m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W3W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。五百五十米處開始上前，走外疊。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W2W2W) Hampered leaving stalls, mid-field, keen mid-race, pushed along 300m out, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W2W2W) 出閘時受阻礙，居中間位置。中段搶口。三百米處受推策，末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W4W) Sat towards rear, switched out rounding the Turn, could not make ground (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W4W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W2W) Ridden along from wide draw to press leader, pushed along on bend to chase leader, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，在催策下追迫領放馬。直路彎受推策以追趕領放馬。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in rear of midfield, badly baulked and lost position after straightening, made no further impression. (See Racing Incidents)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。入直路後嚴重受困及失位。末段再無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W6W) Taken back to race towards rear on the outside, made contact near 1000M and 850M, very wide turning in, made some progress early in straight, no extra final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W6W) 留居後列，走外疊。接近一千米處及八百五十米處時兩度與對手互相觸碰。入直路時走大外疊。直路早段略為追前，最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Raced wide towards rear, lost position early in home straight, well held final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居後列，走外疊。直路早段失位。最後二百米遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat near the rear on the rail, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Settled in last few and waited with, went wide into home straight, ran on under pressure down the centre of the track, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 居最後數位之內，留力候上。入直路時走外疊。直路上在跑道中央受催策上前。以末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Slowly away and checked soon after start, outpaced and detached from main body of runners, never competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘緩慢，其後瞬即勒避。未能跟上步速，被主馬群拋離。從未見具競爭力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Taken back from gate 12, raced 2 wide at rear, 7 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W2W) Ridden to join race leader, some 1L back 2-wide rounding home bend, kept on in straight until finding no extra inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W2W) 受催策以追上領放馬。轉直路彎時落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路上保持走勢，最後三百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, gave ground early in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。直路初墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Well back dropping to tail-end inside the 600m, made no impression thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 遙居於後。六百米處墮居包尾位置，其後毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Slowly away, driven along and outpaced early stages, still well held from top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘緩慢。早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。直路初仍遙遙落後。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Settled wide in well back from the widest barrier, trailed the field rounding home bend and into straight, ran past well-beaten runners closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 自最外檔出閘後遙居於後，走外疊。轉直路彎及入直路時尾隨馬群。末段超越數匹已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Taken back to race towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W4W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, angled out approaching 600M, 3 lengths or so back turning in, finished off strongly, won by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。趨近六百米處時向外移出。入直路時落後約三個馬位。末段衝刺強勁，以短距離之先獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Slowly away, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, passed plenty of field but never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。超越不少對手，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled behind mid, no clear running in the Straight, not fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。直路上未能望空。未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Settled worse than midfield, could not be quickened in the Straight, not much impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。直路上未能加速。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Began moderately, never better than midfield and 3-wide most of the way, obtained a clear passage over 300M out but unable to quicken to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，從未超越中間位置，大部分途程走第三疊。三百米處望空，但未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Tracked leaders, ridden along 400m out, well placed into home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策。入直路時居好位。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, kept on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, kept on without threatening top 3.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段保持走勢，未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Caught 3-wide without cover chasing leaders, couldn't sustain run passing 350M and weakened away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 追趕領先馬匹，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。跑過三百五十米處時無以為繼，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began awkwardly, trailed the field to straight, widest turning in for home, only ran past well-beaten horses.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘笨拙。直路前尾隨馬群。轉入直路時走最外疊。僅能超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Took up the front-running position early and posted some very fast sectionals, folded up quickly over final stages and had to pay the price.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 早段取得領先，以甚快步速領放。耗力太多，末段迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Held up, last and plenty to do top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 留後。直路初居包尾位置，落後甚遠。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead 2 wide, weakened final furlong. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側，走第二疊。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Settled in midfield, baulked for a run early in straight and checked 250M out, never recovered.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路早段受困。二百五十米處勒避，其後從未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Ridden forward from a wide barrier reaching 2nd 3-wide 1100M out, one-out-one back rounding home bend holding every chance into straight, unable to sustain effort inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前。千一米處進佔第二位，走第三疊。轉直路彎時落後一個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時一度甚具爭勝機會。最後一百五十米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Travelled 4-wide without cover in back straight, obtained cover 3-wide rounding home bend, carried very wide entering home straight, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 對面直路上走第四疊，沒有遮擋。轉直路彎時走第三疊，取得遮擋。入直路時被帶出大外疊。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) From an awkward draw caught out on a limb, boxed on solidly considering the tough run.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 自第九檔出閘，走外疊，沒有遮擋。儘管耗力甚多，仍持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W2W) Crowded leaving stalls and also shuffled back around halfway, towards rear, stayed on from 400m out, moved into third 150m out, no further impression on front two closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W2W) 出閘時受擠迫。大約半程時墮居後列。自四百米處起持續上前，一百五十米處居第三位。末段未能進一步威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, asked for effort 400m out, stayed on but lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策。保持走勢，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Held up from wide draw, always in rear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 自外檔出閘後留後。一直居後列。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back from wide draw and raced in last pair, well held from early in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居最後兩位內。自直路初起所負頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Sat near the rear 2 wide, never quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居後列，走第二疊。從未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Crowded shortly after start losing ground, soon recovered to 9th towards rear on rail, forced to steady when pace slackened onto first turn, made no impression in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫及失地，瞬即恢復走勢，居後列第九位，走內欄。進入首個彎位步速減慢時被迫收慢。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 9, raced 3 wide with cover towards rear, moved a bit closer on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 自第九檔出閘，留居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎略為追近。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled at the rear early, moved closer to midfield passing 800M, held up 400M to 300M before closing off fairly. No threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，早段居後列。跑過八百米處時追近至中間位置。四百米處至三百米處之間受困，其後衝刺一般，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Slowly away, made up some ground to race rear of mid-field, under pressure 500m out, bumped between rivals 200m out, no real impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘緩慢，略為追前以居中間之後位置。五百米處受催策。二百米處在對手之間發生碰撞。未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W3W) Tracked leaders, challenged and every chance from top of home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自直路初起展開挑戰，已獲機會盡展所長。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon prominent from wide draw, led after 500m, still led by over two lengths 200m out, gradually closed down, headed 50m out and no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，瞬即居前列位置。過了五百米處後領放。二百米處仍領先逾兩個馬位。其後逐漸被追近，五十米處被超越，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, quickened early to lead top of home straight, stayed on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初加速，取得領先。保持佳勢，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Raced towards the rear 3 wide, stayed on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。末段保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Wide in prominent position early, obtained 2nd 2-wide over 1000M out, unable to quicken under pressure in home straight and kept on steadily to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 早段居前列，走外疊。一千米處進佔第二位，走第二疊。直路上在催策下未能加速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, 3 wide from 900M, wider turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時發生觸碰，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。自九百米處起走第三疊。入直路時走更外疊。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure to hold position middle stages, short of room early in home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。中段在催策下保持位置。直路初空位不足。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W4W) Taken back towards the tail of the field and raced keenly throughout the early stages, lacked a strong turn of foot on straightening, made some progress without threatening leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W4W) 留居馬群尾列，早段沿途搶口。入直路時未能以勁勢加速上前。末段略為追前，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Unbalanced at start and soon dropped to last few, commenced move rounding home bend going wide for a run into straight, ran on to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 起步時失去平衡，瞬即墮居最後數位之內。轉直路彎時開始發力，入直路時移出外疊取位。追前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W2W) From draw 14 moved up to track leader, pressed along 500M to be challenging for the lead, peaked on its run 200M, couldn't go on. (Trainer - instructed jockey to go forward from wide barrier.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W2W) 自第十四檔出閘，上前跟隨領放馬。五百米處在催策下挑戰領放馬。二百米處未能再增速，無以為繼。（練馬師指示騎師讓自大外檔出閘的此駒上前。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Raced in touch, keen mid-race, stuck on rail and had to wait for run until 300m out, picked up well to challenge, found only winner too strong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。中段搶口。沿欄受困，須等待空位出現直至三百米處。末段以佳勢加速以展開挑戰。僅不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Sat handy, raced keenly early, traveled wide, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 居前列。早段搶口。走外疊。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped fairly gradually improved to 2L 4th, drifted slightly backward to 4L 6th in midfield onto first bend, renewed effort 500M out shifting 4-wide to challenge into straight, held place chance until swamped inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘一般，逐漸推進至第四位，落後兩個馬位。開始轉首個彎位時略為墮居中間第六位，落後四個馬位。五百米處重新發力。入直路時移至第四疊以展開挑戰。保持入位機會直至最後二百米被超越。

raceinfo_eng.RaceName: LUKFOOK JEWELLERY MISS HONG KONG LOVE YOURSELF COLLECTION HANDICAP

raceinfo_chi.RaceName: 六福珠寶香港小姐悅己愛己系列讓賽

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good(+) (2W2W2W2W) From draw 12 moved up to track leader in a steadily run race, never gave up on straightening only to be gunned down by the winner closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 自第十二檔出閘後上前，跟隨領放馬，賽事步速平穩。入直路時持續力拼。末段僅不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Fast into stride, chased leader on settling, in a good place to pounce but couldn't find the kick under 135lb, just battled home for minor placing.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，追趕領放馬。居於有利爭勝的位置，但在負一百三十五磅下未能增速。末段力拼，僅保住季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began well from the widest barrier before taking back to share 7th 3-wide after the first 300M, drifted some 6L back to 9th 1200M out, fought on steadily under pressure inside final 300M to claim 4th 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，過了首三百米後留後，並居第七位，走第三疊。千二米處墮居第九位，落後約六個馬位。最後三百米在催策下持續力拼。五十米處進佔第四位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, blocked off when trying to switch 500m out, didn't get best of runs in home straight when trying to improve.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處在嘗試轉換跑線之際受困。直路上嘗試推進上前，但取位不太暢順。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W2W1W2W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier to join the leader on first bend, chased within 2L of pace in back straight, similar turning for home when unable to quicken to challenge and swamped inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W2W1W2W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前，在首個彎位追上領放馬。對面直路上落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位。轉直路彎時居相若位置，未能加速以展開挑戰。最後二百米被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W3W3W6W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W3W3W6W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Jumped only fairly and bumped, raced 2 wide in midfield, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, took the lead 250M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。二百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Settled behind midfield early before dropping to the rear on settling, raced keenly with blinkers first time and had nothing to offer when asked. (Jockey - his mount changed stride throughout the event.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 早段居中間之後位置，其後墮居後列。在首次佩戴眼罩下搶口，末段在催策下再無餘力。（騎師表示，坐騎沿途轉腳。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W2W) Bumped and lost balance 1500m out, dropped out from wide draw and quickly improved to rail position in mid-field, angled off rail 450m out, ran on well to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，迅速上前進佔中間位置，走內欄。千五米處與對手互相碰撞，失去平衡。四百五十米處移離內欄。末段以佳勢上前，終點線上僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, followed winner through 300m out, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。三百米處跟隨頭馬上前。保持佳勢，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W3W1W1W) Settled in second half of the field early stages, raced keenly and made rapid forward move from 900M to take lead, held on gamely when challenged by rivals on both sides in the straight. Gutsy win.
(Jockey dropped whip near 150M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(2W3W1W1W) 早段居後半馬群中，搶口。自九百米處起迅速上前，取得領先。直路上受兩側對手挑戰，以勁勢力拒來犯，憑鬥志勝出。
（於接近一百五十米處時騎師跌掉馬鞭。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於接近一百五十米處時騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (1W1W) Bumped on jumping, took the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, weakened final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(1W1W) 躍出時發生碰撞，取得領先。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路早段保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, led by 2 lengths turning in, kicked clear early in straight, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先兩個馬位。直路早段帶離餘駒，保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, chased along on bend, stayed on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。直路彎追趕對手。在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) From draw 1 settled in midfield along the fence, under pressure long way from home and was pretty weak in the straight. (Jockey - did not travel throughout on its first race start at the Valley.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，居中間位置，沿欄競跑。離終點尚遠時已受催策，直路上走勢頗弱。（騎師表示，首次在跑馬地上陣的坐騎沿途走勢欠順。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, switched to make run 600m out, stayed on under pressure, tight for room close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處轉換跑線推進。在催策下保持走勢。接近終點時受緊迫。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W1W3W) Dropped back to race at the back of the field 10Ls off leader on settling, made limited progress on straightening and was never in the picture.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W1W3W) 留居後列，落後領放馬十個馬位。入直路時略為追前，從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W4W) Settled in rear of mid-field, ridden 600m out, ran on well final 200m but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W4W) 居中間之後位置。六百米處受催策。最後二百米以佳勢上前，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Settled just worse than midfield in 6th or 7th, came to challenge under pressure upon straightening, ran on steadily to snatch 3rd late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間稍後第六或第七位。入直路時在催策下上前挑戰。末段穩步上前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W3W3W4W) Sat midfield, minor progress under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W3W3W4W) 居中間位置。在鞭策下略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W5W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, one pace to the finish (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W5W) 居中間位置，走勢一般。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) From draw 1 settled down in midfield and enjoyed a ground saving run along the fence, shifted out 250M to challenge before finishing off moderately to take 5th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，居中間位置。沿途走內欄節省腳程。二百五十米處向外移出以展開挑戰，其後衝刺普通，取得第五名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Not far off from leaders early stages before dropping back to race in midfield on settling, bustled along 550M but failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 早段落後領先馬匹不遠，其後墮居中間位置。五百五十米處受催策，但直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, rail position in rear, driven along 550m out, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，居後列，走內欄。五百五十米處受催策，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Ridden after moderate start and checked on heels twice when travelling keenly in early stages, shared 6th 2-wide over 4L back rounding home bend, weakened under pressure approaching home turn.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步普通，其後受催策，早段搶口之際兩度勒避他駒後蹄。轉直路彎時並居第六位，落後逾四個馬位，走第二疊。趨近直路彎時受催策，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Shifted in and bumped shortly after start, rail position in mid-field, pushed along 550m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。五百五十米處受推策。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced behind midfield on the inside, slightly improved along the rail on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎沿欄略為推進。直路初對催策略有反應。二百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Began fairly, settled in rear of midfield on rail in 4L 6th or 5th, did not find much room behind runners on rail early in straight, kept on to the line in closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，居中間之後第五或第六位，落後四個馬位，走內欄。直路早段在馬匹之後空位不足，走內欄。保持走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (2W2W) In 4th place early stages, shuffled back to mid-division when pace slackened mid-race, quickened up sharply passing 400M then put the race to bed quickly winning by good margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(2W2W) 早段居第四位。賽事中段步速減慢時墮居中間位置。跑過四百米處時以勁勢加速，其後迅即控制大局，帶離餘駒取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, travelled smoothly into home straight, briefly hampered 350m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時走勢暢順。三百五十米處一度受阻礙。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。末段衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the outside, 3 lengths or so back turning in, finished off well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑入季席，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, cleared 300M, finished off well to take 2nd, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。三百米處望空，末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, hard ridden after passing 300M, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。跑過三百米處後受力策。衝刺凌厲，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, mid division, travelled smoothly into home straight, strong run to lead 150m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間位置。入直路時走勢暢順。以勁勢上前，一百五十米處取得領先。末段領先距離收窄，但仍保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Soon took up running from draw 2 and had a soft lead throughout, came under siege 300M and gave ground mid-straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自第二檔出閘，瞬即取得領先。沿途輕鬆領放。三百米處受到挑戰。直路中段墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W2W2W) Went forward tracking leader, pace slow middle stages, led 300M out before keeping on well to hold rivals at bay. (Trainer attributed the improved performance being up in distance and being able to race on the pace.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W2W2W) 上前跟隨領放馬。賽事中段步速緩慢。三百米處取得領先，其後保持佳勢，力拒對手勝出。（練馬師將此駒的進步表現歸因於增程角逐，並能夠居前競跑。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled well behind on rail after beginning from a wide barrier, travelled keenly from 1300M out while trailing the field on rail, detached early in straight but ran past well-beaten runners under pressure inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後遙居於後，走內欄。自千三米處起搶口，沿欄尾隨馬群。直路初被拋離，但最後一百五十米在催策下超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Jumped with them, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, carried wider 550M, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。五百五十米處被帶出較外疊。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly and given a waiting ride after the start, shuffled back to the rear when pace slackened middle stages, had task in hand 400M and made up some ground in the run home for a non-threatening 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，其後留力候上。賽事中段步速減慢時墮居後列。四百米處落後甚遠。末段略為追前，取得第四名，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, commenced move out wide 700m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 自大外檔出閘，墮居包尾位置。七百米處開始發力，走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W3W) Eased back to sit in a rearward position 7Ls off the fast pace, shuffled back to last spot making the home turn, brought wide to challenge and finished off mildly to take a non-threatening 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W3W) 收慢留居後列，落後步速甚快的領放馬七個馬位。轉直路彎時墮居包尾位置。移出外疊以展開挑戰。末段衝刺普通，取得第四名，未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) From wide draw given a conservative ride at the rear, had plenty to make up 400M but failed to pick up pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列。四百米處落後甚遠，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W3W3W) Restrained to race in second half of the field, travelled keenly, lost cover from 900M strode forward to chase leaders, run ended mid-straight and had no extra late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W3W3W) 受約束，居後半馬群中，跑來搶口。自九百米處起展步上前追趕領先馬匹，失去遮擋。直路中段無以為繼，末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Made some use take up a position outside the lead, failed to respond to riding in the home straight, weakened badly to finish tailed out. (Unacceptable Performance / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 略受催策上前，佔取領放馬外側位置。直路上對催策毫無反應。末段嚴重轉弱，大敗而回。（表現難以接受。）（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced keenly behind leaders, forward move to challenge 300m out, every chance, faded final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領先馬匹之後，搶口。三百米處上前展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。最後一百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Tracked leader with the pace of the race very slow in middle stages, came under serious pressure 400M before dropping out of contention mid-straight. (Jockey - would derive benefit from its first run back from a spell today.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬，賽事中段步速非常緩慢。四百米處受力策，其後於直路中段再無爭勝機會。（騎師表示，休後復出的坐騎應能從是仗中提升狀態。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W2W) Moved forward tracking leaders, always in touch, couldn't accelerate when the race got serious 450M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W2W) 上前跟隨領先馬匹，一直居啣接位置。四百五十米處在關鍵時刻未能加速上前，只能保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Always thereabouts with rails run, taken some 2L back in 3rd 1200M out, commenced move on straightening and hit the front 300M out, soon drew clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 沿途居啣接位置，走內欄。千二米處留居第三位，落後約兩個馬位。入直路時開始發力，三百米處取得領先。瞬即帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W3W3W) Rail position in mid-field, switched 1200m out to make run 800m out, pushed along 600m out to chase leaders, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W3W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。千二米處轉換跑線，八百米處取位上前。六百米處受推策追趕領先馬匹，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) From a wide draw taken back to last, 10Ls off the pace on settling, had big task in hand top of straight but failed to make real progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留居包尾位置，落後領放馬十個馬位。直路初仍落後甚遠。末段無甚進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, challenged and every chance from 300m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 沿欄跟隨領先馬匹。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。其後保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, mid division, followed winner through 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置。三百米處跟隨頭馬上前。末段未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled in the second half of the field 6-7Ls off leaders, little change at the home turn, responded fairly in the straight and never troubled leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後半馬群中，落後領先馬匹六至七個馬位。直路彎居相若位置。直路上對催策反應一般。從未能對領先馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W3W3W) Jumped only fairly, settled near last in the early stages before moving to midfield halfway, 4Ls off leader top of straight but lacked a strong finishing effort.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般。早段居接近包尾位置，半程時進佔中間位置。直路初落後領放馬四個馬位，但衝刺欠勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Slowly away settling in midfield mainly in 7th on rail, saved ground on the inside turning for home, ran on well under pressure to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，大多居中間第七位，走內欄。轉直路彎時走內欄節省腳程。在催策下以佳勢上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide from 350M, made good progress in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。自三百五十米處起走第二疊。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Given a waiting ride in a position towards the rear, had 7Ls to make up on leader leaving the bend, ran on well under pressure and swept past long time leader near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。跑離直路彎時仍落後領放馬七個馬位。在催策下以佳勢上前，接近終點時超越大部分途程帶頭的領放馬，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) In rear after crowded at start, keen early stages, driven 400m out, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，其後居後列。早段搶口。四百米處受催策。最後二百米以勁勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W3W) Given a waiting ride in a position near the rear, lacked a finishing effort passing 400M. Never in the picture.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W3W) 居後列，留力候上。跑過四百米處時衝刺乏力。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (2W4W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, improved from the 700M, hit the front top of the Straight, keep on strongly to the line, won cozily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(2W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。自七百米處起推進。直路初取得領先。保持勁勢至終點，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W2W) Raced wide, forward move to go upsides leader 700m out, ridden to lead outright 400m out, kept going to repel challengers final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W2W) 走外疊。七百米處上前追迫領放馬。受催策，四百米處單騎領放。最後二百米保持走勢，力拒對手挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W3W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, under pressure from the 800M, took some time to respond, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。自八百米處起受催策，需時對催策作出反應。末段保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W5W) From draw 12 crossed to a 3-wide spot in midfield without cover, travelled well leaving home turn and went for the lead, briefly in front near 100M before losing out in a close finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W5W) 自第十二檔出閘後切入，居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。跑離直路彎時走勢良佳，上前爭奪領先。接近一百米處時一度領先，其後在與頭馬幾乎齊過終點下僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W2W3W2W) Settled in front of midfield, raced keenly in the early stages, commenced to improve rounding the Turn, closed off strongly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W3W2W) 居中間之前位置。早段搶口。轉直路彎時開始推進。以勁勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Mid division, ridden along to hold position middle stages, hung in top of home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置。中段受催策以保持位置。直路初內閃。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W5W) Slowly away, in rear, driven along final bend, held and struggling 400m out, hung right.
(Mucus in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W5W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。直路彎受催策。四百米處受困及掙扎上前，其後內閃。
（氣管有痰。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, commenced move out wide 550m out, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。五百五十米處開始上前，走外疊。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) From draw 1 obtained a midfield position along the inside, cut the corner home turn and quickly moved up to 3rd top of the straight, held for 400M to 300M before running on moderately. Just missed 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初迅速進佔第三位。四百米處至三百米處之間受困，其後走勢普通，僅失季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Bumped start, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, no daylight early in straight, cleared 200M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 起步時被碰撞，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空，二百米處望空，末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Bumped out of stalls, rail position in rear of mid-field, under pressure to hold position 700m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內欄。七百米處受催策以保持位置。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken across to the fence after the start, severely checked 1100M and fell back to detached last, out of contention and wasn't ridden out for the remainder of the race.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後切入內欄。千一米處大力勒避，墮居遙遙落後的包尾位置。再無爭逐機會，在餘下途程上未被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Sat outside the lead, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上轉弱。

raceinfo_chi.RaceName: 六福珠寶冰．鑽光影金系列讓賽

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W) Knuckled over on jumping, settled midfield, unable to quicken 300m out, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W) 躍出時俯首前跪，居中間位置，三百米處未能加速，從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (6W1W) Crowded shortly after start, dropped out from wide draw, followed runner-up through in home straight, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(6W1W) 自外檔起步後不久受擠迫，墮後。直路上跟隨亞軍馬匹上前，衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced behind midfield, 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 起步時向內斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置。轉入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Began well, taken back to race 3 wide towards rear, 5 lengths back turning in, made little progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 出閘迅速，留居後列，走第三疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Ridden along from stalls, tracked pace out wide without cover, steadied for cover halfway out, bumped 350m out, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 出閘後受催策，跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。半程時收慢以取得遮擋。三百五十米處發生碰撞。掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, under pressure 500m out to chase leaders, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W1W) Average to begin, positioned 5 lengths behind the leader, same margin back on turn, made good progress in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W1W) 出閘一般，落後領放馬五個馬位。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Moderately away, raced in midfield, 2 to 3 lengths back, hard ridden approaching 300M but only showed limited response, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通，居中間位置，落後兩至三個馬位。趨近三百米處時受力策，但反應僅屬平平。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W3W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W3W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W3W4W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, some headway 800m out, pushed along widest into home straight, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W3W4W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。八百米處略為追前。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) In rear after slowly away, still in rear top of home straight, good headway early in home straight, no further impression final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，其後居後列。直路初仍居後列。直路早段追前甚多。最後二百米再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began only fairly, taken back to race at rear, 13 lengths back in the middle stages, made very good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居後列。中段落後十三個馬位。直路上追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made minor progress early in straight, peaked on run 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Waited with in rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, switched inside to challenge up rail from 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時須等待空位出現。向內移入，自二百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Began fairly before settling in forward of midfield in 6th one-off the rail, commenced move upon straightening and quickened well inside final 200M to assert authority 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 出閘一般，其後居中間之前第六位，走第二疊。入直路後開始上前。最後二百米加速良佳。最後一百米控制大局，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made contact shortly after start, raced in midfield, nearer to the middle track, hard ridden from 400M but only showed limited response, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。自四百米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W2W) Very wide without cover after beginning from a wide barrier, made swift headway alongside race leader 900M out to be 2-wide in 2nd home bend, unable to sustain effort and swamped inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W2W) 自外檔出閘後走大外疊，沒有遮擋。迅速上前，九百米處與領放馬並跑。直路彎居第二位，走第二疊。末段後勁不繼。最後一百五十米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide behind midfield, wider turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。末段衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W2W1W) Keen in mid-field, allowed to stride forward out wide and led 600m out, headed over 150m out, fading when tight for room closing stages.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W2W1W) 居中間位置，搶口。獲許展步上前，走外疊。六百米處取得領先。一百五十米處被超越。末段受緊迫之際力竭。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Settled well back from a wide barrier, keen when tempo slackened approaching first bend, snuck closer to within 5L of pace on rail in 11th into straight, ran on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後遙居於後。趨近首個彎位時在步速減慢之際搶口。入直路時沿欄追近至第十一位，落後領放馬不逾五個馬位。末段追前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Away well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W) Broke well before settling in rear of midfield, became worse in 8th rounding home bend, ran on well under pressure near the centre of the track to claim 3rd closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之後位置。轉直路彎時居後列第八位。末段靠近跑道中央競跑，在催策下以佳勢上前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Settled just worse than midfield, ran on steadily inside final 250M but without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 居中間稍後位置。最後二百五十米以穩勢追前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W4W) Crowded at start, three wide in mid-field, forced to steady 850m out and raced very wide, stayed on well in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W4W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置，走第三疊。八百五十米處被迫收慢，走大外疊。直路上保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Sat just behind the lead, kept on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居領放馬稍後位置。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (3W3W) From draw 13 caught racing wide no cover outside leaders, picked up nicely early straight and soon took over, kept finding late to hold off challenge from the 2nd. (Trainer questioned re improved performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(3W3W) 自第十三檔出閘，居領先馬匹外側，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初加速良佳，瞬即帶頭競跑。末段持續加速，力拒亞軍馬匹的挑戰掄元。（練馬師被查詢有關此駒的進步表現。）
