runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Tracked leaders, switched for clear run 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, weakened quickly over 300m out, eased final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。三百米處迅速轉弱。最後二百米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Waited with in mid-field, pushed along when tight for room 200m out, no impression when again short of room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置，留力候上。二百米處受推策，但受緊迫。末段再度缺乏空位，毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Caught 3 wide off pace, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後競跑，走第三疊。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Prominent chasing leader under 7lb claimer, fought on early straight to stay in contention, lost 2nd nearing 200M, no extra final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 在獲減七磅的騎師胯下居前列，追趕領放馬。直路初力拼以保持爭逐機會。接近二百米處時失去第二位。末段再無餘力。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Shamexpress from Up A Ghia, a daughter of Pins. Horses by the same sire include Sweet Briar and Ka Ying Rising. He was given nine trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He shared the lead and finished third, beaten by 1-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on June 22. In the latest trial, he was taken back and finished sixth under pressure, beaten by 2Ls, over 1200m on turf at Happy Valley on October 9. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「特快班車」(Shamexpress)之後，在港同父馬包括「瑰麗人生」及「嘉應高昇」等駒，生母出自Pins。抵港後九次試閘一次上名。6月22日出試從化草地1200米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬1.25個馬位。最近10月9日出試谷草1200米，起步居後，末段力策下跑第六名，落後頭馬兩個馬位。初出暫宜觀望。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat at the rear, made good late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Moderately away, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the middle track, same margin back at 400M, kept on well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通，落後領放馬三個馬位，在跑道中央競跑。四百米處落後相同距離。保持佳勢，跑入季席，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; Bumped out of stalls, challenged and every chance from 400m out, one paced and unable to get on terms with leaders.
(Lost left hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;出閘時與對手互相碰撞。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。
（失去左後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly, settled ahead of midfield along the inside, failed to run on when asked top of the straight. Never a threat. (Jockey : his mount was reluctant to improve between runners during the race.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路初受催策時未能追前。從未能構成威脅。（騎師表示，坐騎陣上不願在馬匹之間推進。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled just worse than midfield on rail, baulked for a run after straightening, obtained clear run over 150M out, finished off the race well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間稍後位置，走內欄。入直路後受困。一百五十米處望空。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) In rear after slow start, some headway under pressure but never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。在催策下略為追前，但從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began well, positioned a length behind the leader on the stands' side, hard ridden from 300M, peaked approaching 150M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個馬位，靠近外欄競跑。自三百米處起受力策。趨近一百五十米處時未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped with the field and sat prominent, fought on gamely when asked for an effort.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居前列。在催策下奮勇力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Caught 4 wide near midfield, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居接近中間位置，走第四疊。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Led, weakened from the 150M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 領放。自一百五十米處起轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made running, headed 150m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;帶頭。一百五十米處被超越，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Driven along from stalls to lead 700m out, kicked 300m out, stayed on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘後受催策。七百米處取得領先。三百米處加速。保持佳勢，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Keen in rear, stayed on final 200m, lacked speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列，搶口。最後二百米保持走勢。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Raced ahead of midfield and settled more forward than anticipated, ran home one paced final 400M posing little threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，較賽前預期為前。最後四百米衝刺時保持同速，對領先馬匹無甚威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slow to begin, sat last, stayed on well late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，居包尾位置。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (3W6W) From a wide draw dropped back to near the rear early stages, brought widest 500M from home, came with a big run from well back to get into the placings.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(3W6W) 自外檔出閘，早段留居後列。五百米處移出最外疊。自遙遙落後的位置大幅追前，進佔季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the outside, 6-1/2L back turning in, made some progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六個半馬位。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began only fairly, raced towards rear on the stands' rail, passed some tired runners final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走外欄。最後四百米超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Crowded shortly after the start, raced rear division of mid-field 3 wide with cover, finished off just fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Tracked leader, three wide, effort over 300m out, no extra and lost ground final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。三百米處發力上前。最後二百五十米再無餘力，墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W1W) Attempted to make all from a wide barrier, obtained rails run in front onto home bend, led until finding no extra over 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W1W) 自外檔出閘後嘗試領放。開始轉直路彎時在領放下移入內欄。保持領先，一百米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Away well, sent forward to race prominently, took the lead turning in, peaked and headed 200M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列。入直路時取得領先。二百米處未能再增速及被超越，最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Broke well travelling one back on the rail, baulked for a run on rail until forced to switch 150M out, responded well to hit the front briefly before pipped at the post.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，落後一個馬位，走內欄。沿欄受困，直至一百五十米處被迫轉換跑線。末段對催策反應良佳，一度進佔領先位置，直至在終點僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Chased the leader, raced wide throughout, gave ground in the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 追趕領放馬，沿途走外疊。直路上墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (3W2W) Tracked leader, carried left 300m out, unable to stay with winner final 200m but stayed on to hold second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(3W2W) 跟隨領放馬。三百米處被帶向外跑。最後二百米未能跟上頭馬，但保持走勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began well, positioned 1-1/4L behind the leader on rail, same position on turn, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬一又四分一個馬位，走內欄。直路彎居相同位置。末段以佳勢衝刺，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W2W4W) Sat handy 2 wide, run peaked at 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W2W4W) 居前列，走第二疊。一百米處未能再增速。

raceinfo_eng.RaceName: LUKFOOK JEWELLERY NIGHT BANQUET IN TANG PALACE COLLECTION HANDICAP

raceinfo_chi.RaceName: 六福珠寶唐宮夜宴系列讓賽

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Held a handy position 2Ls on settling , driven along 400M but the final effort was just moderate, out of contention from 200M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居前列，落後兩個馬位。四百米處受催策，但末段衝刺僅屬一般。自二百米處起再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jostled at start, gradually settled well back, commenced move inside the 400M and ran on well to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時受擠碰，逐漸遙居於後。四百米處開始上前，走勢良佳，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sluggish start, mid division, ridden along 400m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步緩慢，居中間位置。四百米處受催策。保持走勢，但未能增速以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sat one off the rail alongside the leader, kept on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居領放馬旁側，走外欄第二疊。末段保持勁勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) Sat near the rear near center, held up until 350M, made good late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)居後列，靠近跑道中央競跑。受困直至三百五十米處。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Tracked pace, under pressure 400m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;跟隨領放馬。四百米處受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Bumped at the start and tracked pace, passed tired lead pair, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;起步時發生碰撞，跟隨領放馬。超越已呈疲態的領先兩駒。末段保持穩勢。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Capitalist from Fimatino, a daughter of Not A Single Doubt. Horses by the same sire include Geneva and Superb Capitalist. This fellow had five starts for three wins (including a maiden over 1100m and a handicap over 1200m) and two placings. He was given two trials for one win and one placing in Hong Kong. He raced handily and won by a neck, under slight pressure, over 1050m AWT at Sha Tin on September 22. In the latest trial, he took the early lead and finished second under slight pressure, beaten by 1-1/4Ls, over 1000m on turf at Sha Tin on October 13. He should run a decent race, with better to come.
formguide.comments_chi: 「巨富」(Capitalist)之後，在港同父馬包括「增強」及「八駿巨昇」等駒，生母出自「勇無疑」(Not A Single Doubt)。來港前在澳洲五戰得三勝兩位，頭馬包括一場1100米從未勝出馬賽，及一場1200米讓磅賽。抵港後兩次試閘得一勝一位。9月22日出試田泥1050米，早段居前競跑，末段稍騎下以一馬頸位之先勝出。最近10月13日出試田草1000米，早段領放，末段稍騎下跑第二名，落後頭馬1.25個馬位。初出或有一定走勢，熱身後應會更進步。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Sun City, who also sired Quantum Cloud, from Novacastrian, a daughter of Magnus. This fellow had six starts for two wins (a 2-3yo maiden handicap over 1200m and a handicap over 1400m) and two placings. He was given two trials for two wins in Hong Kong. He made all to win by 3/4L, under slight pressure, over 1000m on turf in Conghua on September 28. In the latest trial, he sat not far behind the pace and won by 1-1/4Ls under slight pressure, over 1000m on turf at Sha Tin on October 13. He looks a runner of real interest here on debut.
formguide.comments_chi: Sun City之後，另一匹在港同父馬為「天馬行雲」，生母出自「萬利時」(Magnus)。來港前在澳洲六戰得兩勝兩位，頭馬包括一場1200米兩歲及三歲從未勝出馬讓磅賽，及一場1400米讓磅賽。抵港後兩次試閘全勝。9月28日出試從化草地1000米，早段領放，末段稍騎下以0.75個馬位之先勝出。最近10月13日出試田草1000米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段稍騎下以1.25個馬位之先勝出。預計初出會有一定走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) Moderately away, positioned a length behind the leader on the stands' side, no clear run until approaching 200M, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)出閘普通，落後領放馬一個馬位，靠近外欄競跑。未能望空直至趨近二百米處。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Crowded at start, made headway from midfield early to join race leader 600M out, shared pace until finding no extra inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 起步時受擠迫。早段自中間位置追前，六百米處與領放馬並跑。並排領先，直至最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Always well behind, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 沿途遙居於後。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Crowded after the start, soon moved forward and vied for the lead, couldn't go on mid-straight and weakened. (Jockey - disadvantaged when pressured in the lead.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後受擠迫，瞬即上前爭奪領先。直路中段無以為繼，轉弱。（騎師表示，坐騎在領放下受追迫而不利發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Pressed forward from the widest draw to share the pace racing very wide, obtained 2-wide position in front coming onto first turn 600M out, hung on under pressure in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自最外檔出閘後受催策上前，並排領先，走大外疊。六百米處開始轉首個彎位時取得領先，走第二疊。直路上在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced 3 wide towards rear, wider turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列，走第三疊。入直路時走更外疊。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Held up last after slowly away, still in last place 400m out, eye-catching headway from rear final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘緩慢後留居包尾位置。四百米處仍居包尾位置。最後二百米自後列追前甚多。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Farnan from Somethingvain, a daughter of Falkirk. Horses by the same sire include Grand Eagle and Gaudium Magnum. This fellow won his only start (a maiden over 1250m) in Australia. He was given three trials for two placings in Hong Kong. He raced handily and finished second, beaten 3/4L, under pressure over 1200m Conghua on September 21. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished second under the whip, beaten by a short head, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 5. He’s probably not shaping like a first-up winner and this run will undoubtedly improve him.
formguide.comments_chi: 「輝隆」(Farnan)之後，在港同父馬包括「神鵰」及「極歡欣」，生母出自「福城」(Falkirk)。來港前在澳洲一出一捷，頭馬為一場1250米從未勝出馬賽。抵港後三次試閘兩次上名。9月21日出試從化草地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬0.75個馬位。最近10月5日出試從化草地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段鞭策下跑第二名，落後頭馬一短馬頭位。應不足以一出即勝，仍需熱身去提升表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Moderately away, raced in midfield, 2 to 3 lengths back, hard ridden approaching 300M but only showed limited response, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通。居中間位置，落後兩至三個馬位。趨近三百米處時受力策，但反應僅屬平平。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Heavily bumped and lost balance shortly after start, mid division against far rail, good headway halfway out, ran on strongly to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步後不久被大力碰撞，失去平衡，居中間位置，走外欄。半程時以佳勢上前。走勢強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; Prominent, strong run to lead 300m out, on top from there, won cosily.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;居前列。走勢強勁，三百米處取得領先。其後保持領先。從容取勝。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Away well, took narrow lead from 800M, kept on under pressure, headed near 200M and not going the pace of first three late.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;出閘迅速，自八百米處起以短距離領先，在催策下保持走勢。接近二百米處時被超越，末段加速力不及前三名馬匹。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sluggish start and bumped exiting stalls, tracked pace, ridden along 400m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘緩慢，與對手互相碰撞。跟隨領放馬，四百米處受催策。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped start, sent forward to race prominently, inconvenienced shortly after passing 1300M, 3 wide in the middle stages, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，在催策下上前，居前列。跑過千三米處後不久受妨礙，中段走第三疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; Well there and wide without cover, came under pressure to hold place coming onto course proper, dropped out tamely inside final 200M.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;居好位，在離外欄較遠的一方競跑，沒有遮擋。跑離分支直路時在催策下保持位置。最後二百米力竭墮退。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Commenced well, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader on the stands' side, hard ridden after passing 300M, showed very good response, took the lead approaching 150M, kept on very well to the line, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘迅速，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，靠近外欄競跑。跑過三百米處後受力策，反應良佳。趨近一百五十米處時領先。末段保持勁勢，輕鬆勝出賽事。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 5-year-old gelding, by Deep Field from Capital Commander, a daughter of Commands. Horses by the same sire include Self Improvement and Voyage Bubble. This fellow had nine starts for one win (a maiden handicap over 1200m) and three placings. He was given six trials for one win and one placing in Hong Kong. He made the run and finished second, beaten by 3/4L, under pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on June 26. In the latest trial, he shared the lead and won by 1/2L under pressure, over 1000m on turf in Conghua on September 28. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「遙遠星空」(Deep Field)之後，在港同父馬包括「自強不息」及「遨遊氣泡」等駒，生母出自「聽命」(Commands)。來港前在澳洲九戰得一勝三位，頭馬為一場1200米從未勝出馬讓磅賽。抵港後六次試閘得一勝一位。6月26日出試從化草地1200米，早段領放，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬0.75個馬位。最近9月28日出試從化草地1000米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下以半個馬位之先勝出。初出暫宜觀望。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Contributer from Little Haast, a daughter of Faltaat. Horses by the same sire include Fortune Boy and Quick Contribution. This fellow won his only start (a 3yo maiden over 1300m). He was given five trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished fourth under pressure, beaten by 6-3/4Ls, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 6. He’s probably not looking like a first-up winner but this race will give us a chance to look at him more closely.
formguide.comments_chi: 「立功者」(Contributer)之後，在港同父馬包括「火焰閃爍」及「飛躍成就」等駒，生母出自Faltaat。來港前在紐西蘭一出一捷，頭馬為一場1300米三歲從未勝出馬賽。抵港後試閘五次。最近10月6日出試田泥1200米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第四名，落後頭馬6.75個馬位。不似能一出即勝，觀望為宜。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Toronado from Bianslick, a daughter of Bianconi. Horses by the same sire include Helios Express and Little Paradise. This fellow had one start for one win (a maiden over 1262m). He was given two trials for one placing in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he shared the lead and finished third under slight pressure, beaten by 1/2L, over 1000m on turf in Conghua on October 12. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「豪華房車」(Toronado)之後，在港同父馬包括「驕陽明駒」及「小鳥天堂」等駒，生母出自Bianconi。來港前在澳洲一出一捷，頭馬為一場1262米從未勝出馬賽。抵港後兩次試閘一次上名。最近10月12日出試從化草地1000米，早段並頭領放，末段稍騎下跑第三名，落後頭馬半個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the middle track, 3 lengths back at 400M, made minor progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，在跑道中央競跑。四百米處落後三個馬位。其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, outpaced and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後三百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, outpaced and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路初受催策。最後三百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover in the middle stages, peaked on run 500M, weakened gradually in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走外疊。中段沒有遮擋。五百米處未能再增速。直路上逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Raced very wide throughout in rear of mid-field, some headway on bend, forced to steady 100m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間之後位置，沿途走大外疊。直路彎略為追前。一百米處被迫收慢，其後未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W) Settled handy, traveled smoothly, responded nicely under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居前列，走勢暢順。對鞭策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Blundered at the Start, sat rear, badly held up in the Straight until 100M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 起步時失蹄，居後列。直路上嚴重受困直至一百米處。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, same margin back on turn, angled out early in straight, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路初向外移出。以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Broke well settling in midfield on rail, badly crowded and dropped quickly out of contention 600M out, never recovered.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處嚴重受擠迫及迅速墮退，再無爭勝機會。從未恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W5W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced near the rear always, failed to pick up in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W5W) 出閘笨拙及失地，沿途居後列。直路上未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W2W) Disputed led early stages, pressed leader middle stages, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, pressed by runner-up to line and just prevailed.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W2W) 早段爭奪領先。中段追迫領放馬。直路初加速，二百米處取得領先。被亞軍馬匹追迫至終點，僅勝。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Across to press leader, quickened early to lead top of home straight, headed 200m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 切入以追迫領放馬。直路初加速，取得領先。二百米處被超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Crossed from wide draw to make running, headed over 200m out, no extra and lost ground final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後切入，帶頭競跑。二百米處被超越。最後一百米再無餘力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Settled in midfield along the inside, ran home only fairly from 300M. Never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內疊。自三百米處起衝刺僅屬一般。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Broke well from a poor draw, gradually settled just off the pace 3-wide without cover, bumped and lost further ground 600M out, weakened from 3.5L 5th into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，逐漸居領放馬稍後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處發生碰撞及進一步失地。入直路時居五位，落後三個半馬位，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Away well, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader, nearer to the middle track, hard ridden approaching 300M, took the lead 100M, peaked and headed 50M, finished 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘迅速，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，靠近跑道中央競跑。趨近三百米處時受力策。一百米處取得領先。五十米處未能再增速，被超越。跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Raced on outer in mid-field, good headway to challenge 150m out, ran on strongly as first two drew clear, narrow winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置，離外欄競跑。其後追前甚多，一百五十米處展開挑戰。末段走勢強勁，與第二位馬匹雙雙帶離餘駒。以短距離之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Raced in touch with leaders, smooth headway halfway out, pressed on 200m out, strong run to win going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;跟隨領先馬匹。半程時以暢順走勢上前。二百米處受催策。末段走勢強勁，帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; Began well from gate 1, taken back to race behind midfield on the middle track, 2 to 3 lengths back at 400M, hard ridden from 250M and made some progress, no extra final 50M.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;自第一檔出閘迅速，留居中間之後位置，在跑道中央競跑。四百米處落後兩至三個馬位。自二百五十米處起受力策，略為追前。最後五十米再無餘力。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Prominent, pushed up to lead 400m out, ran on well but joined by winner 100m out, no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居前列。四百米處在推策下取得領先。保持佳勢，但一百米處被頭馬追上，不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, moved a bit closer on turn, angled out 550M, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎略為追近。五百五十米處向外移出。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 自大外檔出閘後留後，居包尾位置。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled towards rear, traveled okay, made steady ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居後列，走勢尚可。末段以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Just behind midfield early stages, gained closer to within 3L of pace in 6th rounding home bend, baulked for a run on rail the length of home straight, virtually not tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 早段居中間稍後位置。轉直路彎時追近至第六位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。直路上沿欄受困。從未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Held up last, still in last place top of home straight, good headway early in home straight, ran on strongly and beaten only narrowly,
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置，以佳勢追前。末段走勢強勁，僅以短距離之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Taken back to race at rear on the inside, there to turn, finished off well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎前居相同位置。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Soon taken well back, over 7L off the pace rounding home bend, commenced move upon straightening running on steadily to reach distant 3rd late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 瞬即留居遙遙落後的位置。轉直路彎時落後領放馬逾七個馬位。入直路時開始上前。穩步上前，末段進佔落後頗遠的第三位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Jumped on terms, given a waiting ride towards the rear, ran on mildly from 400M and wasn't beaten far by the placegetters.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居後列，留力候上。自四百米處起保持普通走勢，負於亞軍及季軍馬匹不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled last on the rail, held up in the Straight, stayed on okay once in the clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居包尾位置，走內欄。直路上受困。望空後即保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled in front of midfield, traveled nicely, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之前位置，走勢良佳。衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) Bumped by rival on jumping, reserved in midfield before quickening up from 400M. Put in a sustained effort to lead inside 100M winning comfortably in the end.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)躍出時被對手碰撞，留居中間位置。自四百米處起加速。持續上前，一百米處取得領先，最終輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W2W) Began fairly, recovered to midfield 700M out, ran on well in straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W2W) 出閘一般。恢復走勢，七百米處進佔中間位置。直路上以佳勢上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, forced to steady on heels 800m out, wide into home straight, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。八百米處被迫收慢避開他駒後蹄。入直路時走外疊。最後二百米走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Checked shortly after start, well behind until gaining closer from the 500M along the rail, quickened to reach within 2L of pace on straightening but baulked for a run inside final 200M until the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久勒避。遙居於後，直至自五百米處起沿欄追近。入直路時加速，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位，但最後二百米受困直至一百米處。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Waited with in rear, good headway from halfway, chased leader final 150m, unable to quite peg back that rival.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居後列，留力候上。自半程起追前甚多。最後一百五十米追趕領放馬，但未能超越該駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Led steadily, came under siege early straight, battled on well to hold his leader spot before gave way grudgingly to first 3 final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 以平穩步速領放。直路初受挑戰。以佳勢力拼，保持領先，末段被三甲馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W1W) Chased the leader, traveled nicely, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W1W) 追趕領放馬，走勢良佳。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Ridden early to share the pace, obtained outright lead on rail 1000M out and led until headed inside the 400M, soon faded in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策，並排領先。一千米處沿欄單騎領放。四百米處被超越。直路上瞬即力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Vied for lead early crossing to rail in front just inside the 1100M, kicked 2L clear briefly rounding home bend before joined into straight and eventually headed inside the 200M. (Riding in home straight questioned.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 早段爭奪領先，跑過千一米處後切入內欄領放。轉直路彎時加速，一度帶離兩個馬位。入直路時被追上，二百米處被超越。（騎師被查詢在直路上的騎法。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Soon took up running from a poor draw, set a fast tempo after obtaining rails run 1200M out, led the field until overhauled inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘瞬即取得領先。千二米處移入內欄後以快步速領放。保持領先直至最後二百米被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Quickly into stride, led and set fast pace to the straight, headed passing 400M, held 2nd to about 150M, no extra close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 展步迅速，取得領先。直路前以甚快步速領放。跑過四百米處時被超越。保持居第二位直至約一百五十米處。接近終點時再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Began fairly, soon recovered along the rail to just over 2L back in 4th, drifted from 1L off to over 2L back when pace quickened around the bend, gave ground steadily under pressure from approaching home turn.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，瞬即恢復走勢，居第四位，落後稍逾兩個馬位，走內欄。轉直路彎時賽事步速加快，由落後一個馬位墮退至落後逾兩個馬位。自趨近直路彎起在催策下逐漸墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat handy, raced in restricted room from 600M, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居前列。自六百米處起在窄位競跑，走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Jumped on terms, settled in midfield but never too far behind leaders, switched into clear passing 200M before giving a strong kick to get up just in time.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，但從未遠離領先馬匹。跑過二百米處時轉換跑線以望空，其後以勁勢加速，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Inconvenienced at start from the widest barrier before gradually taken back for cover, obtained cover 2-wide in 9th onto first turn dropping to last into straight, produced good late impression under pressure final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 自大外檔起步時受妨礙，其後逐漸留後以取得遮擋。開始轉直路彎時居第九位，走第二疊，有遮擋。入直路時墮居包尾位置。最後二百米在催策下追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped leaving stalls, dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘時發生碰撞，墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W) Slowly away, held up last, pushed along 500m out, still plenty to do top of home straight, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W) 出閘緩慢，留居包尾位置。五百米處受推策。直路初仍落後頗遠。最後二百米以勁勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Crowded at start, tracked leaders, travelled smoothly to chase leaders top of home straight, strong run to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 起步時受擠迫，跟隨領先馬匹。走勢暢順，直路初追趕領先馬匹。走勢強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) With leaders early stages, taken one back to joint 3rd some 2L off the pace in back straight, slightly further away in 4th rounding home bend, ran on under pressure to hit the front 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 早段跟隨領先馬匹。對面直路上留後一個馬位，並列第三位，落後領放馬約兩個馬位。轉直路彎時略為墮退至第四位。在催策下上前，一百米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Chased the leader, gave ground quickly passing 200M, not much impression made (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;追趕領放馬。跑過二百米處時迅速墮退。無甚表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Not hurried early stages, given a waiting ride towards the rear but failed to run on under top weight. Never in the picture. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段未受催策，居後列，留力候上，但在負頂磅下未能追前。從未有力一爭。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, under pressure 550m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百五十米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Blundered shortly after start, sent forward to race prominently, took the lead near 950M, challenged by rival turning in, headed early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久失蹄，受催策上前，居前列。接近九百五十米處時取得領先。轉入直路時受對手挑戰。直路初被超越，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled in 3rd, some 4L off the fast pace rounding home bend, kept on at the same pace early in straight but swamped for a placing inside final 80M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居第三位。轉直路彎時落後步速甚快的領放馬約四個馬位。直路早段保持同速，但最後八十米被後上馬匹超越，失去一席位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Jumped with them, raced better than midfield but trapped wide, sent forward after passing 1000M, 2nd in the middle stages, kept on well early in straight, peaked 250M, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，但走外疊。跑過一千米處後在催策下上前。中段居第二位。直路早段保持佳勢。二百五十米處未能再增速，最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W2W) From wide draw sent forward to chase leader, quickened up nicely early straight to take the lead near 200M, continued on well late stages and held on from the fast finishing runner-up.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W2W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前追趕領放馬。直路初以佳勢加速。接近二百米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢，力拒衝刺強勁的亞軍馬匹險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Sat behind midfield, minor progress made when asked.
Lost left front plate.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;居中間之後位置。受催策時略為追前。
失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W2W) Settled rear, switched out rounding the turn, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W2W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Ridden forward to within 2L of pace 2-wide in 4th, travelled keenly on heels of leaders from between the 1100M and 900M, drifted slightly backward to 5th approaching final turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 受催策上前，居第四位，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位，走第二疊。千一米處至九百米處之間緊隨領先馬匹，搶口。趨近直路彎時略為墮居第五位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, ridden top of home straight, stayed on steadily but no further impression on front two late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路初受催策。末段保持穩勢，但未能進一步威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Fast into stride, took the early lead, headed near 950M, 2nd on turn, retook the lead early in straight, peaked and headed 250M, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，早段取得領先。接近九百五十米處時被超越。直路彎居第二位。直路初再度取得領先。二百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled about 6L off the pace in joint 4th 2-wide, in similar position into straight, fought on steadily without threatening .
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 並列第四位，落後領放馬約六個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時居相若位置。末段持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back, there to turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Waited with towards rear, still plenty to do top of home straight, challenged against rail from 200m out, ran on strongly to lead final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍落後頗遠。自二百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。衝刺強勁，最後五十米取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Began smartly from a wide draw, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on strongly in straight and won by 1-1/2L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持勁勢，以一個半馬位之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, box seat, well placed into home straight, quickened early in home straight to lead 300m out, ran on strongly to kick two lengths clear 200m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居包廂位置。入直路時居好位。直路初加速，三百米處取得領先。走勢強勁，二百米處加速帶離對手兩個馬位，帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began smartly from gate 13, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked 250M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第十三檔出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策略有反應。二百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W) Commenced well, raced in 3rd, a length or so back, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood at the left nostril.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第三位，落後約一個馬位。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）
（左邊鼻孔有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Fast away from the stalls and sat up on leader's girth, struck the lead when asked 300m out, but unable to hold off the strong-finishing challenger.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居領放馬外側。三百米處在催策下取得領先，但未能抗衡衝刺強勁的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, challenged and every chance from 400m out, stayed on for pressure, weakened close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自四百米處起展開挑戰，已獲機會盡展所長。在催策下保持走勢。接近終點時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Bumped start, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, 7 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 起步時發生碰撞，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, held up behind midfield, swung wide from 500M, kept on steadily to the line without posing serious threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，留居中間之後位置。自五百米處起移出外疊。保持穩勢至終點，未能對領先馬匹構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Out with rest, raced slightly better than midfield, no cover throughout, 1-3/4L back turning in, finished off very strongly, led close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍前位置。沿途沒有遮擋。入直路時落後一又四分三馬位。衝刺凌厲，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Began awkwardly losing ground, soon recovered to just worse than midfield mostly in 9th on rail, travelled keenly home bend and forced to steady 600M out, not much room early in straight, obtained a clear run 260M out, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘笨拙及失地，瞬即恢復走勢，大多居中間稍後的第九位，走內欄。直路彎搶口，六百米處被迫收慢。直路早段空位不足，二百六十米處望空，末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W4W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 500M, 6 lengths or so back turning in, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W4W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後約六個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made very good progress in straight to make frame, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W) 自最外檔出閘，留居後列競跑，走外疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly from draw 1, settled down in midfield about 3Ls off pace, kept on one paced in the straight. Never a serious threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，落後領放馬約三個馬位。直路上保持同速。從未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled fairly, weakened passing 100M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 在催策下領放。走勢一般。跑過一百米處時轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Pressed forward from a poor draw, obtained one back 2-wide position 1100M out, in similar position but 3rd onto home bend, switched out to challenge 400M out, fought on dourly to get up final strides and just defy late challenges.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前。千一米處居第二位，走第二疊。開始轉直路彎時居相若位置，但墮居第三位。四百米處向外移出以展開挑戰。末段力拼，最後數步取得領先，僅能力拒對手的挑戰，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Quickly into stride, up with early pace before sitting back to track leaders, run ended 250M then weakened rapidly to finish last.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 展步迅速，早段跟上步速，其後留後，跟隨領先馬匹。二百五十米處無以為繼，其後迅速轉弱，包尾而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped awkwardly, raced in midfield but never far off from leaders, stayed on reasonably well final 300M. Not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘笨拙，居中間位置，但從未遠離領先馬匹。最後三百米保持頗佳走勢，所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Driven forward form draw 10 to take up running, shook off rivals early straight to open up 2.5L lead mid-straight, caught by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 自第十檔出閘後受催策上前領放。直路早段擺脫對手，直路中段帶離兩個半馬位。接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Shifted in at start, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on rail, saved ground throughout, challenged the leaders early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時向內斜跑，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。直路初挑戰領先馬匹。一百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sped forward to take up running, raced keenly entering back straight, opened up a big lead before steadying the pace home turn, ran on again final 200M to hold pursuing rivals at bay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 加速上前帶頭。進入對面直路時搶口。遙遙領先，其後在直路彎減慢步速。最後二百米再度上前，力拒緊追的對手掄元。

raceinfo_eng.RaceName: LUKFOOK JEWELLERY HEIRLOOM FORTUNE COLLECTION HANDICAP

raceinfo_chi.RaceName: 六福珠寶福滿傳家系列讓賽

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Recovered quickly from an awkward start to soon take up running, held 1L advantage rounding home bend and into straight, hung on well under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，迅速恢復走勢，瞬即取得領先。轉直路彎及入直路時領先一個馬位。在催策下保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Wide without cover in midfield after beginning from a wide barrier, shifted back to 11th for cover 3-wide approaching first bend 1000M out, made no impression from wide into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘後居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。一千米處趨近首個彎位時留居第十一位，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走外疊，毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W) Sat outside lead, kept on okay, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持不俗走勢，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Heavily bumped and lost balance shortly after start, raced in touch with leaders, good headway halfway out, ran on well to close on leaders but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步後不久被大力碰撞，失去平衡，跟隨領先馬匹。半程時以佳勢上前。走勢良佳，追近領先馬匹，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; In rear after awkward start, never any room to open up from 300m out, coasted past a few rivals final 150m, never seriously tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘笨拙，其後居後列。自三百米處起從未能望空。最後一百五十米輕鬆超越數匹對手。從未能真正施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race 2 wide at rear, wider after passing 800M, very wide turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，留居後列，走第二疊。跑過八百米處後走更外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) From draw 3 obtained a midfield position along the fence, driven along 400M but only showed limited response. Never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第三檔出閘，居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處受催策，但反應僅屬平平。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped exiting stalls, tracked leaders, under pressure to chase leaders 600m out, stayed on well, lost second close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。其後保持佳勢。接近終點時失去亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, found rail 550M, no daylight early in straight, made minor progress after passing 250M, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。五百五十米處移入內欄。直路早段未能望空。跑過二百五十米處後略為追前。一百米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Bumped exiting stalls, mid division, pushed along wide 500m out, short-lived challenge top of home straight, stayed on for pressure final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。五百米處受推策，走外疊。直路初一度發力挑戰。二百米處在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, no clear run top of the Straight, closed off strongly once in the clear, won cozily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路初未能望空。末段望空後隨即以勁勢衝刺，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled ahead of midfield in 5th spot, ran home one paced final 400M. Never going the pace to challenge. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前的第五位。最後四百米保持同速。從未能加速上前展開挑戰。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走勢尚可。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Midfield on rail early stages, made headway 1400M out to be 2L 3rd onto home bend, badly baulked for a run after straightening until the 300M, ran on to hold every chance throughout final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 早段居中間位置，走內欄。千四米處上前。開始轉直路彎時居第三位，落後兩個馬位。入直路後嚴重受困直至三百米處。末段沿途保持走勢，一度甚具爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly, chased the leader, traveled smoothly, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，追趕領放馬，走勢暢順。衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Dropped out from widest draw, three wide without cover, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米以勁勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, bumped 700m out, good headway on bend, challenged and every chance from 400m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。七百米處碰撞他駒。直路彎追前甚多。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Jumped on terms and settled midfield 4-5L back, had some ground to make up turning for home but lacked a finishing kick.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，落後四至五個馬位。轉入直路時仍落後頗遠，但末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on outer, 6 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Settled behind midfield 3 wide, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Tracked pace against inside rail, chased winner from 300m out, unable to quite match that rival but stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 沿欄跟隨領放馬。自三百米處起追趕頭馬。末段未能追上頭馬，但保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Mid-field, good headway between horses to challenge 200m out, responded well and on top final 50m, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 居中間位置。二百米處在馬匹之間以佳勢上前展開挑戰。對催策反應良佳，最後五十米取得領先。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W) Waited with, still in rear top of home straight, stayed on final 200m, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W) 留力候上。直路初仍居後列。最後二百米保持走勢，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Settled towards the rear on the rail, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居後列，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W5W) Not the quickest out, settled just off midfield 2 wide, ran on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W5W) 出閘並非最快，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。末段追前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Settled down in midfield racing keenly middle stages, held up for clear running 350-250M and again from 200M-150M before running on nicely late stages to claim 4th. Could do better.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。中段搶口。三百五十米處至二百五十米處之間及二百米處至一百五十米處之間兩度受困而未能望空。末段以佳勢上前，取得第四名。本應可有更佳發揮。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Not the quickest out, settled off pace on the rail, angled out in the Straight, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘並非最快，居領放馬之後，走內欄。直路上向外移出。末段衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Sat 3 wide behind midfield, closed off well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W3W) Bumped leaving stall, held up, plenty to do top of home straight, angled out at 300m line, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，留後。直路初落後甚遠。三百米處向外移出。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Slowly away, held up, headway up inside rail over 300m out, no further impression final 100m, short of room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，留後。三百米處沿欄追前。最後一百米再無表現。末段空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 7 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Raced in touch, under pressure 300m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。三百米處受催策。末段轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Dropped steadily to last few in back straight, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 對面直路上逐漸墮後，居最後數位之內，其後再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked pace, pushed along 300m out, stuck to task but lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處受推策。持續力拼，但未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, bumped 700m out and lost balance, taken wider on bend, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。七百米處被碰撞，失去平衡。直路彎被帶出較外疊。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, just one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。末段在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Sat worse than midfield, had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early Straight, failed to respond (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置。直路早段難以望空。對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began only fairly, given a waiting ride at the rear 6-7Ls back, gave limited response when asked, raced in restricted room final 100M and not ridden out. (Jockey - better suited by stepping back up in distance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，落後六至七個馬位，留力候上。對催策反應平平。最後一百米在窄位競跑，未能被力策。（騎師表示，坐騎增程回師較長途程應較合發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Held up last, blocked off when going for run 400m out, clear run final 150m, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 留居包尾位置。四百米處在試圖取位之際受困。最後一百五十米望空，但未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, had to wait for run turning into home straight, switched for clear run 300m out, some late gains.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Waited with in rear, headway halfway out against rail, stayed on for pressure in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。半程時上前，走內欄。直路上在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Waited with towards rear, switched inside for clear run top of home straight, ran on strongly final 300m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初移入內疊望空。最後三百米衝刺強勁，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly from gate 1, raced towards rear on the inside, moved a bit closer along the rail on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。直路彎沿欄略為追近。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted in and bumped leaving stalls, held up last, ridden along 600m out, short of room 400m out to 200m out, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，留居包尾位置。六百米處受催策。四百米處至二百米處空位不足。最後二百米以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Towards rear, pushed along halfway, left behind.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居後列。半程時受推策。末段被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Mid-field, stayed on steadily final 300m, got up for second on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。最後三百米保持穩勢。終點線上進佔亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Not hurried early stages, given a waiting ride towards the rear 3-wide , ran past beaten rivals in the straight for a midfield finish. (Jockey - raced greenly throughout.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 早段未受催策，居後列，留力候上，走第三疊。直路上超越數匹已洩氣的對手，居中間位置過終點。（騎師表示，坐騎沿途走勢稚嫩。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Wide in mid-field, lost position entering home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時失位。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Sat last, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Driven along and outpaced early stages, detached halfway out, ridden out to finish, little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段受催策，未能跟上步速。半程時被拋離。被力策至終點。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Broke well from a middle barrier, struggled to find cover in midfield 4-wide before heading forward inside the 1000M eventually joining race leader approaching home turn, found no extra inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 自中檔出閘迅速。難以取得遮擋，居中間位置，走第四疊。一千米處上前，趨近直路彎時追上領放馬。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, driven along 600m out, short of room top of home straight, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策。直路初空位不足。最後二百米以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, no clear run until 200M, ran on well afterwards.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。未能望空直至二百米處，其後以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Mid-field, stayed on well for pressure final 300m, unable to reach winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。最後三百米在催策下保持佳勢，但未能追及頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W2W) In rear, still plenty to do top of home straight, short of room when trying to improve 300m out, stayed on well once clear final 200m, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W2W) 居後列。直路初仍落後甚遠。三百米處在嘗試推進時空位不足。最後二百米望空後保持佳勢，但未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W3W) Broke well before settling towards rear in 8th or 9th, ran on under pressure in straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，其後居後列第八或第九位。直路上受催策上前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, angled out in the Straight, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路上向外移出。衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Raced in rear after slow start, plenty to do 400m out and switched towards centre of track, stayed on, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘緩慢，居後列。四百米處落後甚遠，移至跑道中央。保持走勢，以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Raced in rear after slowly away, pushed along towards centre of course 350m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘緩慢，居後列。三百五十米處在跑道中央受推策。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Sat rear, traveled on the rail, minor progress made (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段略為上前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Away with them, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Mid-field, stayed on for pressure home straight, in third place briefly over 100m out, outpaced final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路上受催策，保持走勢。一百米處一度居第三位。最後五十米速度不及前列馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Keen under restraint in mid-field, short-lived headway over 200m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 在受約束下搶口，居中間位置。二百米處一度追前。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, raced keenly, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。搶口。末段對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sat at the rear on the rail, picked off some weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Bumped on jumping, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W4W) Began well from a poor draw, gradually shifted backward to worse than midfield, commenced move on top of home bend over 500M out, ran on from 3L back into straight to snatch victory final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W4W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，逐漸留後至中間之後位置。直路彎早段五百米處開始上前。入直路時落後三個馬位，其後追前，最後數步獲得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well but soon taken over 2L back to 5th, fought on steadily along the rail but without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，但瞬即留後逾兩個馬位，居第五位。沿欄以穩勢力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W1W2W) Broke well from the one draw settling in 2nd chasing within 2L of the pace, came to challenge making final turn drawing level early in home straight, but no match to winner's burst of speed 300M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居第二位，追趕至落後領放馬不足兩個馬位。轉直路彎時展開挑戰。直路初並排領先，但三百米處未能與頭馬的加速力抗衡。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Caught wide early stages, improved to race outside leader, failed to pick up early straight and looked beaten, made up some ground late however and not beaten far by the placegetters at the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 早段走外疊，其後推進至領放馬外側。直路初未能加速，看似洩氣，但末段略為追前，終點線上負於入位馬匹不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded at start, gradually settled in 5th on rail some 4L back, closer to lead when tempo slackened in back straight, came under pressure home bend and saved ground turning in, found no extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，逐漸居第五位，落後約四個馬位，走內欄。對面直路上在步速減慢下追近領放馬。直路彎受催策，入直路時走內疊節省腳程。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Tracked pace, shuffled back to mid-field 700m out, ridden and left behind final 400m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 跟隨領放馬。七百米處墮居中間位置。最後四百米受催策，但被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-division 3-4Ls off leader in a slowly run race, little change in position to the straight, kept on fairly to the line. Never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W3W) 居中間位置，落後領放馬三至四個馬位，賽事步速緩慢。直路前位置大致不變。末段保持一般走勢，從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Settled over 3L back in 5th, drifted slightly further off the pace in fast tempo around home bend, soon weakened under pressure after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 居第五位，落後逾三個馬位。轉直路彎時在快步速下略為墮後，進一步落後領放馬。入直路後在催策下瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Never better than midfield, saved ground on the inside turning in for home, soon dropped out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 從未超越中間位置。入直路時走內疊節省腳程，瞬即再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Hampered at start dropping to last few, came under pressure over 500M out to challenge into the straight, found nothing under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 起步時受阻礙，墮居最後數位之內。五百米處受催策以在入直路時展開挑戰。在催策下再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Settled in last few after a moderate start and waited with in 8th some 6L off the pace, commenced move approaching home turn and finished off the race well inside final 150M, did beset work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘普通，其後居後列第八位，落後領放馬約六個馬位，留力候上。趨近直路彎時開始上前。最後一百五十米衝刺良佳。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Crowded at start, raced in touch with leaders, followed runner-up through 600m out, hung in but ran on strongly to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 起步時受擠迫，跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處跟隨亞軍馬匹上前。末段內閃，但衝刺強勁。接近終點時取得領先，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, followed winner through 400m out, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處跟隨頭馬上前。走勢良佳，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Moderately away from gate 1, positioned a length behind the leader, 2 wide turning in, kept on very well in straight, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘普通，落後領放馬一個馬位。入直路時走第二疊。直路上保持甚佳走勢，僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the outside, moved closer after passing 1000M, 1-1/2L back turning in, showed good response in straight, challenged the leader 150M, bumped 100M, kept on well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走外疊。跑過一千米處後追近。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路上對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處挑戰領放馬。一百米處與對手互相碰撞。保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Shifted in and heavily bumped out of stalls, mid division, under pressure on bend to chase leaders, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與對手互相大力碰撞，居中間位置。直路彎在催策下追趕領先馬匹。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Close up behind leaders early stages before drifting back to midfield, came under pressure on the home turn and failed to finish off. (Trainer couldn't offer explanation for the disappointing run.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 早段緊隨領先馬匹，其後墮居中間位置。直路彎受催策。末段未能以勁勢衝刺。（練馬師未能就此駒令人失望的表現提供任何解釋。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W2W) Settled in last few in 6th on rail some 6L off the pace, further away in increased pace around home bend, obtained clear run inside 300M and quickened well, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W2W) 居最後數位之內的第六位，落後領放馬約六個馬位，走內欄。轉直路彎賽事步速加快時落後更遠。最後三百米望空，以佳勢加速。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Reserved in midfield 5Ls off the steady pace, quickened up well in the straight to be challenging for the lead, in front near 150M but couldn't hold off winner final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 留居中間位置，落後步速平穩的領放馬五個馬位。直路上以佳勢加速，爭奪領先。接近一百五十米處時取得領先，但末段未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Travelled in midfield 6-7Ls off the pace middle stages, in 4th spot throughout, couldn't improve position final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。中段落後領放馬六至七個馬位。沿途居第四位。最後四百米未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Settled in second half of the field 4-5Ls off the pace, responded fairly on straightening and was unable to make ground on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居後半馬群中，落後領放馬四至五個馬位。入直路時對催策反應一般，未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, taken wide 300m out, quickened well to pass rivals and lead 150m out, kept going to line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。三百米處移出外疊。加速良佳，超越對手，一百五十米處取得領先。末段保持走勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, mid division, under pressure 400m out, ran on well and lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 出閘時向外斜跑，與一駒互相碰撞，居中間位置。四百米處受催策。以佳勢上前，僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Box seat, short of room top of home straight, ridden along 300m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。直路初空位不足。三百米處受催策。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted in at start, across to press leader, quickened early to lead 550m out, kicked three lengths clear 200m out, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑，切入追逼領放馬。早段加速，五百五十米處取得領先。二百米處加速帶離三個馬位。輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Box seat, well placed into home straight, pressed on 300m out, ran on strongly to lead 200m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。入直路時居好位。三百米處受催策。二百米處衝刺強勁，取得領先。帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Out with rest, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, commenced move 550M, 1-1/2L back turning in, kept on well in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。五百五十米處開始發力。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, switched for clear run 500m out, quickened early to lead 250m out, headed by winner 100m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處轉換跑線以望空。直路早段加速，二百五十米處取得領先。一百米處被頭馬超越，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide from 800M, angled out 500M, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。自八百米處起走第三疊。五百米處向外移出，直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Raced wide, improved to lead 1200m out, soon headed by rival top of home straight, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 走外疊。千二米處上前領放。直路初瞬即被對手超越。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) From a middle draw obtained running in midfield 3-4Ls off the fast pace, had no clear running early straight, crowded near 200M and didn't run on thereafter. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 自第六檔出閘，居中間位置，在快步速下落後三至四個馬位。直路早段未能望空。接近二百米處時受擠迫，其後未能上前。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early in home straight to lead 300m out, headed by winner 150m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路初加速，三百米處取得領先。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W1W1W1W) Set slow pace first half of the race, was taken on by rival from 800M, battled hard on straightening, lost lead nearing 200M and weakened late stages. Held on for 4th just.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 賽事前半程以慢步速領放。自八百米處起受對手挑戰。入直路時力拼。接近二百米處時失去領先位置。末段轉弱，僅能保住第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Not the quickest out, ridden along to lead, travelled comfortably, kept on well to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘並非最快，受催策，取得領先。走勢暢順。末段保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, pushed along 600m out to chase leaders, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處受推策，追趕領先馬匹。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W2W3W) Raced in a handy spot behind leaders, well placed to strike 400M, fought well to wrestle the lead 100M out, all out final stages just couldn't hold off winner near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W2W3W) 居領先馬匹之後的好位。四百米處居有利爭勝位置。一百米處以佳勢爭奪領先。末段力拼，僅於接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W3W) Blundered start and made contact, raced 2 wide, 1 to 2 lengths back, bumped 400M, wider turning in, took the lead 250M, kept on well but unable to hold off the first two close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 起步時失蹄及與對手互相觸碰，落後一至兩個馬位，走第二疊。四百米處發生碰撞。入直路時走更外疊。二百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但於接近終點時未能抗衡頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Sat off pace on the rail, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居領放馬之後，走內欄。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced in second half of the field 8Ls off leader, kept on same pace in the straight and never able to trouble leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後半馬群中，落後領放馬八個馬位。直路上保持同速。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled in 5th positioned in second half of the field throughout, kept on same pace in the straight posing little threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般。沿途居後半馬群的第五位。直路上保持同速，對領先馬匹威脅不大。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Never better than mid-division of the small field, commenced move from over 2L back in 5th into straight but unable to make any impression throughout.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 在九駒中從未超越中間位置。入直路時從落後逾兩個馬位的第五位開始發力，但末段全程毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Settled midfield 2 wide, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, still in rear top of home straight, unable to reach leaders,
(Jockey dropped whip at 200M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。未能追上領先馬匹。
（於二百米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W5W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W5W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W1W2W) Sat handy, traveled nicely, made good ground inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W1W2W) 居前列。走勢良佳。最後二百米追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W3W2W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race at tail, 6 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W3W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W5W) Mid division, switched wide with cover 800m out, pushed along wide into home straight, strong run to lead 150m out, stayed on well to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W5W) 居中間位置。八百米處移出外疊，有遮擋。入直路時受推策，走外疊。衝刺強勁，一百五十米處取得領先，保持佳勢，保住勝局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W3W4W) Stayed close to leaders but raced wide without cover for the majority of the race, hard driven from 450M, responded well to be challenging for the lead final stages, held by first two at the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W3W4W) 緊隨領先馬匹，但大部分途程走外疊，沒有遮擋。自四百五十米處起受力策，反應良佳。末段爭奪領先，過終點時落後首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W2W) Away well, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, made contact near 400M, no clear early in straight, cleared approaching 200M, kept on well until final 50M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。接近四百米處時與對手互相觸碰。直路初未能望空。趨近二百米處時望空。保持佳勢直至五十米處。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W4W) Ridden along from stalls to track leaders, chased leaders 450m out, one paced and unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 出閘後受催策，跟隨領先馬匹。四百五十米處追趕領先馬匹。保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Sat on pace, unable to quickened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居前列。直路上未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) From draw 3 raced just behind leaders throughout, fought hard to stay in contention from 300M, couldn't accelerate enough final 150M and made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第三檔出閘，沿途居領先馬匹稍後位置。自三百米處起力拼以保持爭逐機會。最後一百五十米加速力不足，再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Stayed close enough behind leaders, moved up to challenge 400M, badly crowded between rivals 150M before fading away over concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。四百米處上前展開挑戰。一百五十米處在馬匹之間嚴重受擠迫。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden along 500m out, headed 300m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。五百米處受催策。三百米處被超越。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Away on terms, moved up to be tracking the pace on outside, kept up the chase on leader turning home, fought hard but was held by first two late stage. Hung on for 3rd just.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，上前跟隨領放馬，走外疊。入直路時持續追趕領放馬，但末段未能追上頭兩名馬匹。僅保住季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Ended up racing in midfield along the 3-path, soon left behind on straightening and finished tailed out. (Jockey - failed to show sufficient pace to go forward as instructed due to the ""Soft"" track conditions.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時瞬即被拋離，大敗而回。（騎師表示，由於「軟地」的場地狀況，坐騎未能展現足夠前速以如指示般上前。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Sent forward from wide draw and raced upsides leader, weakened final 200m.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前，追逼領放馬。最後二百米轉弱。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W4W) Held up last, lost balance and lost ground 800m out, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W4W) 留居包尾位置。八百米處失去平衡及失地。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Waited with in rear, had to wait for run top of home straight, switched wide for clear run 250m out, ran on strongly close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初須等候空位出現。二百五十米處移出外疊以望空。接近終點時以勁勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W4W) Settled at the back, quickened well inside final 200M and did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W4W) 居後列。最後二百米以佳勢加速上前，末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W) Raced 3-wide at the rear, unable to make up ground in the straight. (Jockey was advised he had made error of judgement by not improving position in early stages to avoid racing wide and without cover.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W) 居後列，走第三疊。直路上未能追前。（小組告誡騎師，他於早段未有讓坐騎上前以免坐騎在沒有遮擋下走外疊屬判斷錯誤。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, still in last place top of home straight, switched for clear run 250m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，墮居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。二百五十米處向外移出以望空。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, some headway final bend, widest into home straight, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎略為追前。入直路時走最外疊。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, ridden top of home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路初受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field with cover, followed runner-up through 500m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。五百米處跟隨亞軍馬匹上前。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Crowded start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled mainly in rear of midfield on rail, found no extra inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 大多居中間之後位置，走內欄。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back from the outside barrier, sat at the rear, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) From wide draw obtained a midfield position, 3Ls off the pace 400M, worked home evenly in the run home for 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，居中間位置。四百米處落後領放馬三個馬位。末段保持穩勢，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W3W5W) Raced behind midfield 5-6Ls back, swung wide into straight then closed off well down the outside. Went 2nd near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W3W5W) 居中間之後位置，落後五至六個馬位。入直路時移出外疊。其後在外疊衝刺良佳。接近終點時跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Settled towards rear, made a mid-race move near 1100M, gave ground quickly in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居後列。中段接近千一米處時發力上前。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W2W2W) Failed to show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position and settled behind midfield 6Ls off leader, had some work to do 400M but failed to come into the race.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W2W2W) 未能展現足夠前速以佔取更為靠前的位置，居中間之後位置，落後領放馬六個馬位。四百米處仍落後頗遠，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Sent to the lead under 7lb claimer, raced keenly and did not settle which resulted in the early and middle stages being run inside of standard time, headed nearing 200M then weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 由獲讓七磅的見習騎師策騎，受催策上前領放。搶口及未能穩定走勢，導致賽事早段及中段的步速較標準時間為快。接近二百米處時被超越，其後轉弱。
