runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Caught wide early stages, retrained to a rear spot settled further back than intended, had some work to do 400M but made only limited progress to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 早段走外疊，其後受約束以居較賽前部署為後的後列位置。四百米處落後頗遠，但末段僅能略為上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, ridden along final bend, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎受催策。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Settled in mid-field, commenced move out wide 800m out, sustained headway to join leader 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。八百米處開始上前，走外疊。持續追前，二百米處追上領放馬。末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked pace, trapped behind horses for much of home straight, clear over 100m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。直路上大部分途程在馬群之後受困。一百米處望空，但未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Across from widest draw to lead, challenged by rivals top of home straight, headed 100m out, weakened close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後切入領放。直路初被對手挑戰。一百米處被超越。接近終點時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Made running on rail and joined rounding home bend, kicked 1L clear into straight but unable to sustain effort inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 領放，走內欄。轉直路彎時被追上。入直路時加速帶離一個馬位，但最後一百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to track leader, driven 500m out to chase leader, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘後受催策，跟隨領放馬。五百米處受催策，追趕領放馬。末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide, a length back, 3 wide turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run approaching 100M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，落後一個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路初略為追前。趨近一百米處時未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Shifted out at start and bumped, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑及被碰撞，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Raced prominently, outpaced by leaders final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居前列。最後二百米被領先馬匹拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled smoothly, bumped over the concluding stages, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 在催策下取得領先，走勢暢順。末段與對手互相碰撞。已獲機會盡展所長。

raceinfo_eng.RaceName: LUKFOOK JEWELLERY LONGMEN VAJRA COLLECTION HANDICAP

raceinfo_chi.RaceName: 六福珠寶龍門金剛系列讓賽

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, wide into home straight, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時走外疊。保持走勢，但未能加速以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Shifted out at start, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, dropped towards rear on turn, 6 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路彎墮居後列。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Disputed lead, unable to match winner from 300m line but stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 爭奪領先。自三百米處起未能追上頭馬，但持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W3W) Commenced well, raced better than midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, tended to hang out throughout, forced to steady on heels 700m out, lost touch final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。沿途傾向外閃。七百米處被迫收慢避開他駒後蹄。最後三百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Controlled the tempo up front after a quick getaway, fought bravely final stages only fell short to a classy horse.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，其後上前，主宰步速。末段奮勇力拼，僅負於實力強勁的一駒，所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W) Went for the lead on jumping from draw 11, crossed to the fence 800M and led steadily, was strongly challenged by rival final 250M but kept going well to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W) 自第十一檔出閘後上前帶頭。八百米處切入內欄，以平穩步速領放。最後二百五十米受對手以勁勢挑戰，但保持佳勢，保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, briefly hampered 400m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。四百米處一度受阻。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, travelled strongly into home straight, ran on strongly to lead 100m out, pressed by runner-up to line and just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時走勢強勁。以勁勢上前，一百米處取得領先。末段被亞軍馬匹追迫，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, pushed along halfway out, strong run final 200m to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。半程時受推策。最後二百米走勢強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Away well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length in the middle stages, peaked and headed 250M, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前取得領先。中段領先一個馬位。二百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Bumped on jumping, driven forward chasing leaders in a 3-wide spot without cover, checked by the riderless horse at 450M, couldn't go on in the straight. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 躍出時發生碰撞，受催策上前追趕領先馬匹，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。四百五十米處勒避鞍上無人的馬匹。直路上無以為繼。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Across to lead from wide draw after 300m, ran on well for pressure final 200m and always holding runner-up by clear margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，跑了三百米後切入領放。最後二百米在催策下以佳勢上前，一直帶離亞軍馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Shifted out on jumping and was bumped, stayed close enough to leaders, ran on steadily final 300M but couldn't accelerate enough to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 躍出時向外斜跑及被碰撞，落後領先馬匹不遠。最後三百米保持穩勢，但加速力不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, pushed along on bend, some late gains but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎受推策。末段略為追前，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Dropped back from a wide draw, held up in last 6-7Ls off the pace, picked up nicely in the straight and made nice inroads under top weight 135lb to take 3rd just before line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘，墮居包尾位置，落後領放馬六至七個馬位。直路上加速良佳，在負頂磅一百三十五磅下追前甚多，過終點前跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, raced in rear, driven along 400m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列。四百米處受催策。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W1W) From wide draw taken back to last and was given a waiting ride, 8Ls behind leader 400M, closed off fastest under top weight but couldn't be ridden out final 50M when held up between rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留居包尾位置，早段未受催策。四百米處落後領放馬八個馬位。在負頂磅下末段衝刺最快，但最後五十米在對手之間受困時未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Restrained to race towards the rear, 4-5Ls off leader 400M, closed off fastest to claim 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 受約束，居後列。四百米處落後領放馬四至五個馬位。末段衝刺最快，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, commenced move out wide 400m out, ran on well to close on leader but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處開始發力，走外疊。以佳勢追近領放馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W2W) Obtained a midfield spot along the inside, held up 300M-200M before quickening up strongly to win by dominant margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內疊。三百米處至二百米處之間受困，其後加速強勁，帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Pressed leader, good headway to lead top of home straight, pressed on 300m out, kicked 3 lengths clear 200m out, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路初以佳勢上前，取得領先。三百米處受追迫。二百米處加速帶離三個馬位，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, stayed on steadily, briefly hampered close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。保持穩勢，接近終點時一度受阻礙。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, under pressure top of home straight, headed 300m out, dropped away quickly final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初受催策。三百米處被超越。最後一百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sat outside the leader, gave ground final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Went forward, in 3rd spot 1200M, continued to press leader down the back-straight, had nothing left turning home and weakened to last. (Jockey questioned his riding tactics.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 上前。千二米處居第三位。對面直路上持續追迫領放馬。轉直路彎時再無餘力，其後轉弱，包尾而回。（騎師被查詢騎法。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W3W) Shifted in and crowded at start, settled in mid-field, under pressure 700m out, stayed on well but no match for front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W3W) 起步時向內斜跑，受擠迫，居中間位置。七百米處受催策。末段保持佳勢，但不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W3W) Pressed along to be chasing leaders, couldn't quicken with rivals passing 300M, no extra late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W3W) 受催策以追趕領先馬匹。跑過三百米處時未能與對手一起加速，末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Settled in mid-field, switched wide 550m out, bumped 350m out, never on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。五百五十米處移出外疊。三百五十米處發生碰撞。從未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, pressed leader, ridden 250m out, strong run to lead final 50m, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，追迫領放馬。二百五十米處受催策。衝刺強勁，最後五十米取得領先。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Shared lead early stages before settling down in 3rd, couldn't find extra gear to challenge leaders and was comfortably held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 早段並排領先，其後居第三位。未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹，始終未能追近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, challenged leaders early in home straight, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初挑戰領先馬匹。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Raced in rear, shifted out and keen 900m out, ridden along 500m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列。九百米處向外斜跑，搶口。五百米處受催策。毫無表現。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Per Incanto from My Hope, a daughter of Howbaddouwantit. Horses by the same sire include Raging Blizzard and A Americ Te Specso. This fellow had three starts for two wins (a 3yo maiden over 1000m and a handicap over 1000m). He was given three trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat not far behind the pace and finished sixth under the whip, beaten by 4-3/4Ls, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 8. He is not looking like a first-start winner here.
formguide.comments_chi: Per Incanto之後，在港同父馬包括「精算暴雪」及「有財有勢」等駒，生母出自Howbaddouwantit。來港前在澳洲三戰得兩勝，頭馬包括一場1000米三歲從未勝出馬賽，及一場1000米讓磅賽。抵港後試閘三次。最近10月8日出試田泥1200米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段鞭策下跑第六名，落後頭馬4.75個馬位。不似能一出即勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Began well, sent forward to take the lead, headed near 450M, peaked on run 250M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。接近四百五十米處時被超越。二百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Took up a forward position as expected, fought hard passing 400M to stay in contention, inconvenienced near 200M when winner hung in, beaten to 4th near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;如預期般佔取前列位置。跑過四百米處時力拼以保持爭逐機會。接近二百米處時在頭馬內閃之際受妨礙。接近終點時洩氣，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Held narrow running early stages, some 1L off the pace on stands rail onto course proper, held every chance inside final 200M but unable to sustain effort close to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;早段以短距離領先。跑離分支直路時落後領放馬約一個馬位，走外欄。最後二百米一度甚具爭勝機會，但接近終點時無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden to narrow lead well off the rail from the 4 draw before settling 2-wide as joint leader 800M out, held position under pressure early in straight until swamped inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第四檔出閘，受催策，以短距離領先，走外疊。八百米處並排領先，走第二疊。直路早段在催策下保持位置，最後一百五十米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped awkwardly, soon in a prominent position racing down the center of track, couldn't quicken as well as the leaders final 200M. Comfortably held in 5th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘笨拙，瞬即居前列，在跑道中央競跑。最後二百米加速力不及領先馬匹。未能追近，取得第五名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Tracked pace, raced towards centre of course, pushed along 400m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;跟隨領放馬，在跑道中央競跑。四百米處受推策。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W2W) Across to press leader, challenged leader turning into home straight, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W2W) 切入追迫領放馬。入直路時挑戰領放馬。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Settled in mid-field, followed runner-up into home straight, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。跟隨亞軍馬匹入直路。自四百米處起受催策，但未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前，獲得季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Tracked pace out wide without cover early stages, improved to track leaders two wide with cover 600m out, effort 400m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 早段跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處推進以跟隨領先馬匹，走第二疊，有遮擋。四百米處發力，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Caught wide no cover chasing leaders, had no extra final 200M and weakened out of contention. (Jockey - obliged to make use early stages to hold a forward position.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 追趕領先馬匹，走外疊，沒有遮擋。最後二百米再無餘力，轉弱，再無爭逐機會。（騎師表示，他須於早段催策坐騎以佔取前列位置。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Moderately away from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently, 3 wide, there to turn, kept on very well in straight, always just held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，受催策上前，居前列，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持甚佳走勢，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Wide early, improved to track leaders out wide without cover 800m out, effort 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 早段走外疊。推進以跟隨領先馬匹，八百米處走外疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處發力。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Jumped well from gate 12, raced prominently on the outside, 1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Commenced well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made all, kicked 400m out, stayed on well in home straight and soon in command, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 一放到底。四百米處加速。直路上保持佳勢，瞬即控制大局。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Box seat, well placed into home straight, bumped and lost balance 300m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居包廂位置。入直路時居好位。三百米處被碰撞，失去平衡。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W2W2W) Allowed to stride on and take narrow lead before halfway, headed 200m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 獲許展步上前，半程前領先短距離。二百米處被超越，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W1W) Jumped well and led on the rail, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，沿欄領放。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (4W2W1W1W) Wide early, sent forward and led after 500m, headed over 200m out, soon weakened.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(4W2W1W1W) 早段走外疊。受催策上前，跑了五百米後領放。二百米處被超越，瞬即轉弱。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden along to chase leaders against rail 500m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策，沿欄追趕領先馬匹。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, had to wait for run top of home straight, clear run 250m out, strong run to lead 150m out, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路初須等待空位出現。二百五十米處望空。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Ridden from a middle barrier to vie for lead early, gaining 1L 2nd 4-wide onto first bend, soon came to tackle leader in home straight and hit the front 300M out only to be outsprinted 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 自中檔出閘後受催策，早段爭奪領先。開始轉首個彎位時進佔第二位，落後一個馬位，走第四疊。直路上瞬即上前挑戰領放馬。三百米處取得領先，僅於一百五十米處被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped with them, sent forward to race in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, positioned 1-1/4L behind the leader on rail, easy run to turn, showed good response in straight, took the lead 150M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner close home.
(Sustained a small wound to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a small wound to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一又四分一個馬位，走內欄。直路彎前走勢輕鬆。直路上對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。
（右後腿有一個細小傷口。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, blundered near 850M, angled out 450M, kept on well in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近八百五十米處時失蹄。四百五十米處向外移出。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Exceed And Excel from Dathanna, a daughter of Dubawi. Horses by the same sire include Gustosisimo and King Miles. This fellow had nine starts for one win (a 3yo+ maiden over 1000m) and four placings. He was given two trials for one win and one placing in Hong Kong. He sat midfield and won, under a hold, by 1-1/4Ls over 1000m on turf in Conghua on September 21. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished third under a hold, beaten by 2Ls, over 1000m on turf at Sha Tin on October 13. He should run a decent race, with better to come.
formguide.comments_chi: 「盡善盡美」(Exceed And Excel)之後，在港同父馬包括「得道猴王」及「安康萬里」等駒，生母出自「杜拜威」(Dubawi)。來港前在澳洲九戰得一勝四位，頭馬為一場1000米三歲及以上從未勝出馬賽。抵港後兩次試閘得一勝一位。9月21日出試從化草地1000米，早段居中，末段按韁下以1.25個馬位之先勝出。最近10月13日出試田草1000米，早段居前競跑，末段按韁下跑第三名，落後頭馬兩個馬位。初出或有一定走勢，熱身後應會更進步。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (4W3W4W) Jumped awkwardly, soon recovered but forced to steady when within 2L of pace in 7th 1100M out losing ground, thereafter remained 3-wide without cover in last few, made no further impression.
Blood in trachea.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(4W3W4W) 出閘笨拙。瞬即恢復走勢，千一米處居落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位的第七位時被迫收慢，失地。其後居後列，仍走第三疊，沒有遮擋。再無表現。
氣管內有血。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Stumbled leaving stalls, raced in touch with leaders, effort 450m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘時失蹄，早段緊隨領先馬匹。四百五十米處受催策。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, held up top of the Straight, closed off nicely once in the clear, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路初受困。末段望空後以佳勢衝刺，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Jumped well, raced better than midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Zoustar from Fundamentalist, a daughter of Not A Single Doubt. Horses by the same sire include Patch Of Theta and Californiatotality. This fellow had eight starts for three placings (including a 3yo group three over 1300m and a 3yo group two over 1600m). He was given three trials for one win and one placing in Hong Kong. He shared the lead and finished second under pressure, beaten by 1/2L, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on September 22. In the latest trial, he raced handily and won by 1L under pressure, over 1000m on turf at Sha Tin on October 13. He looks a nice horse and could run well here on debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「摘星勇驥」(Zoustar)之後，在港同父馬包括「手機錶霸」及「加州動員」等駒，生母出自「勇無疑」(Not A Single Doubt)。來港前在澳洲八戰三次上名，上名賽事包括一場1300米三歲三級賽，及一場1600米三歲二級賽。抵港後三次試閘得一勝一位。9月22日出試田泥1200米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬半個馬位。最近10月13日出試田草1000米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下以一個馬位之先勝出。潛質不俗，預計初出會有良好走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前，居前列。三百米處挑戰領放馬。穩步上前，一百米處取得領先。末段被亞軍馬匹追近，保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders against rail, angled out for clear run 300m out, ran on well to close on winner, lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 緊隨領先馬匹，走內欄。三百米處向外移出以望空。末段以佳勢追近頭馬，僅以短距離之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Crowded at start, three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, angled out in the Straight, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上向外移出。衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Held up, had to wait for run turning into home straight, switched 200m out for clear running, stayed on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 留後。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。二百米處向外移出以望空。在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, keen middle stages, taken wider into home straight, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。中段搶口。入直路時被帶出較外疊。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Chased the leader, traveled nicely, made good ground inside 200M to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 追趕領放馬。走勢良佳。最後二百米追前甚多。掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Pressed leader, ridden and challenged leader top of home straight, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路初在催策下挑戰領放馬。保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped on terms and tracked leaders, raced keenly middle stages, close enough turning home but could only keep on at the same speed final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，跟隨領先馬匹。中段搶口。轉入直路時落後不遠，但最後四百米僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Tracked leaders against rail, challenged and every chance from 400m out, ran on well to lead 250m out, headed by winner 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。以佳勢上前，二百五十米處取得領先。一百米處被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, pressed leader, challenged leader top of home straight, stayed on but no further impression on front two late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，追迫領放馬。直路初挑戰領放馬。保持走勢，但末段未能進一步威脅首兩名馬匹。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by North Pacific from Dylan's Deeva, a daughter of Dylan Thomas. Horses by the same sire include Cosmo Dragon and Skyward Bound. This fellow had four starts for one win (a maiden over 1450m) and two placings. He was given two trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat nor far behind the pace and finished fifth under pressure, beaten by 1-1/4Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on Ocotber 12. He’s probably not shaping like a first-up winner and this run will undoubtedly improve him.
formguide.comments_chi: North Pacific之後，在港同父馬包括「宇宙威龍」及「予躍天翔」等駒，生母出自「狄倫」(Dylan Thomas)。來港前在澳洲四戰得一勝兩位，頭馬為一場1450米從未勝出馬賽。抵港後試閘兩次。最近10月12日出試從化草地1200米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下跑第五名，落後頭馬1.25個馬位。應不足以一出即勝，仍需熱身去提升表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Soon taken well back from a wide barrier, came under pressure rounding home bend but found nothing.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘，瞬即遙居於後。轉直路彎時受催策，但再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, rail position in mid-field, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, never going pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。未能望空直至二百米處。從未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Crowded and bumped leaving stalls, raced in rear, still in rear top of home straight, briefly hampered 200m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 出閘時受擠迫及發生碰撞，居後列。直路初仍居後列。二百米處一度受阻礙，未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, mid division, had to wait for run top of home straight, driven 300m out, ran on well final 200m to close on winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。直路初須等待空位出現。三百米處受催策。最後二百米以佳勢上前，追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, challenged leaders 600m out, quickened early to lead top of home straight, headed 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處挑戰領先馬匹。直路初加速，取得領先。一百米處被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Bumped after the start, restrained at the rear and caught wide no cover throughout, made only limited progress in the straight and was never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 起步後發生碰撞，受約束。沿途居後列，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路上僅能略為追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W) Settled in midfield, baulked for a run in home straight until over 250M out, ran on well under pressure to hit the front 150M out and soon drew clear.
(Jockey dropped right rein for a number of strides at 200M.)
runnerrecords.incident_eng: (Jockey dropped right rein for a number of strides at 200M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路上受困直至二百五十米處。在催策下走勢良佳，一百五十米處取得領先，瞬即帶離對手勝出。
（於二百米騎師在數步之間右邊韁繩脫手。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於二百米騎師在數步之間右邊韁繩脫手。）

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Flying Artie from Ascalon, a daughter of Makfi. Horses by the same sire include My Wish and Chill Buddy. This fellow had two starts for one win (a 3yo+ maiden over 1550m). He was given five trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished sixth under pressure, beaten by 3Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on September 18. He should run a decent race, with better to come.
formguide.comments_chi: 「飛速雅迪」(Flying Artie)之後，在港同父馬包括「祝願」及「超寫意」等駒，生母出自「馬勁飛」(Makfi)。來港前在澳洲兩戰得一勝，頭馬為一場1550米三歲及以上從未勝出馬賽。抵港後試閘五次。最近9月18日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第六名，落後頭馬三個馬位。初出或有一定走勢，熱身後應會更進步。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, jumped a section on the track 1250m out, hampered 900m out, pushed along wide into home straight, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。一千二百五十米處跳避跑道上的影子。九百米處受阻礙。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段以佳勢上前，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped nicely, sat outside the lead, kept on well to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居領放馬外側。保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Made all, pressed on 350m out and soon in command, kicked two lengths clear 100m out and in control, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 領放。三百五十米處受催策，瞬即控制大局。一百米處加速帶離兩個馬位，穩操勝券。從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Bumped start, raced towards rear, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out after passing 500M, 4-1/2L back turning in, made some headway in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。跑過五百米處後向外移出。入直路時落後四個半馬位。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Dropped out last from wide draw, hung right under pressure 400m out, good headway final 200m, ran on strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置。四百米處在催策下內閃。最後二百米追前甚多。以勁勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Made contact with the left side of its starting gate on jumping, raced at rear on the inside, moved a bit closer after passing 1000M, 2 wide from 700M, no daylight early in straight, cleared 200M, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 躍出時觸碰閘廂左側，居後列，走內疊。跑過一千米處後略為追近。自七百米處起走第二疊。直路初未能望空。二百米處望空。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。
